college_info.intro:
Dayalbagh Educational Institute Agra, offers various courses to students at the UG and PG levels. The Institute also offers various Certificate and Diploma programmes to students across several specialisations. DEI Agra flagship courses include BTech and BSc programmes, which are offered to students for a duration of 4 years and 3 years, respectively.
DEI Agra admission is offered to candidates on the basis of merit and entrance, therefore, candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 60% in Class 12. In addition to this, candidates must secure valid scores in previously attempted examinations. Dayal Bagh Agra courses are offered with a tuition fee ranging from INR 5.3K to INR 34.8 K.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Voc. in AI andRobotics - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure, but the college life is not too good.

review_content.Placements: So, since I am in 2nd year, no one is placed, but the batch that passed this year had around 40 students, approximately and 10 have been placed. The highest package that my senior got is around 13 LPA, but he got off-campus placement, so I can't say college is good at placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Well, the infrastructure has all the things needed for our course, all the labs, equipment, Wi-Fi, and we have a library in every faculty. The girls' and boys canteen is different, the boys canteen staff are rude, and the food is not enjoyable as well. Teachers are great, and the engineering faculty has IITs.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Completely satisfied with placements, good faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Almost all students get placed with an average package of 6 LPA, and the top recruitment companies are Honda, Tata, JSW Group, etc. The roles offered are GET, and you become an assistant manager in one year, so a decent managerial post is offered by companies, which is a white-collar job.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the course is well-maintained, and the basic necessary infrastructure is provided for the course. The canteen is not very good, having very little food variety, but the books in the library are provided for every semester at a very basic price. In addition, you can issue books from the library using your library card.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: College is the best for middle-class students because it is affordable all over Uttar Pradesh.

reviews_list.batch_info: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Footwear Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: This college is amazing for middle-class students because it has the lowest fee in all of India.

review_content.Placements: Footwear technology from Dayalbagh Educational Institute gave almost 100% placement because in Agra, there are many leather industries and good opportunities to start our own business. Students gave their best for placement and to maintain the college's reputation.

The department of Faculty of Engineering is too kind and moral.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Voc. in AI andRobotics - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Good experience overall, but faculty support during placements and needs improvement.

review_content.Placements: Most of the students 70% are placed in Delhi (IT sector). The minimum package is 4 LPA to 6 LPA. paragraphs: XLRI Delhi admissionsare currently open. Candidates interested in taking admission in any of the offered programmes must first fill out the application form. XLRI conducts XAT to shortlist candidates for admission to PGDM programmes. Below is step-wiseXLRI Delhi admission process:
STEP 1: XLRI Delhi Application Process 2026

Candidates seeking admission in PGDM programme have to register on the official portal of XAT. The application fee for XAT isINR 2,200andINR 200each for every additional programme of XLRI. Besides, aspirants can also apply for PGDM IEV on the official website of XLRI Delhi.
STEP 2: XAT & Selection

Candidates seeking admission PGDM programme must appear for XAT. It is an online entrance test conducted once in a year. Besides, aspirants can also apply with a valid score in CAT, MAT, ATMA, CMAT, GMAT, or CUET for PGDM IEV. Furthermore, aspirants must also submit a Statement of Purpose (SOP) and a 5-minute video (Comprehensive Business Plan - Ideation/MVP/Traction) for the PGDM IEV. Further, selected candidates have to pass a personal interview round conducted by the institute.
STEP 3: Cutoff

Once the XAT results are out, cutoffs are released for PGDM programmes. Those who score equal or above theXLRI Delhi cutoffare considered for admission. The final merit list is a cumulative of the performance of the candidates in all the rounds.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation & Fee Payment

The institute sends offer letter to the shortlisted aspirants. Further, selected candidates have to accept the offer and report at the campus for document verification. Aspirants also need to pay theXLRI Delhi feesto confirm their seat.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed in B.Tech CSE, which is approximately 100 to 150 students. The food in the mess is also good.

It is also accredited by NBA SMIT is one of India’s premier technology and management institutes. Spread across 35 beautifully landscaped acres, the campus is home to over 3200 students, 220 members of faculty and a large and efficient team of support staff.The academic standard of SMIT is at par with the best institutes in the country. A highly qualified and dedicated faculty ensure that the students are provided with a holistic education that makes them job ready, industry ready and most important, life ready.

review_summary.college_name: SMIT Sikkim Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review from a first year student.

content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students are placed from my course. The highest package is around 12 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA-3 LPA. Microsoft, Dell, Amazon, etc., are recruiting companies. 85-90 percent of students got internships with top recruiters like Accenture, Amazon, IBM, as software engineer, data analysts, and full-stack developers.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi-enabled smart classrooms, advanced labs, supported by a large library with centralised air-conditioners, 24/7 power backup, hostels with attached bathrooms, a health centre inside the campus, sports complex with pool, gym with multiple activities room.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, a worthy off-campus view, knowledgeable faculty members, and average placements

content.Placements: I am currently in my 5th semester of B.Tech (CSE), and the most recent pass-out 2025 batch are placed in reputed companies. In our 5th semester, recently a US healthcare company, Vivnovation, visited offering ₹15,000 per month as an intern role and a PPO of 22 LPA on satisfactory work performance. This year, the 2025 pass-out percentage of students placed stood at 76.5%, with 268 getting placed out of 350. The highest in-campus package offer is by Amazon, PwC, and Microsoft, which are 14 LPA, 12 LPA, and 8 LPA respectively. The roles are SAP Consultant and TS.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (AI and IoT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: All-around campus with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Currently B.Sc. Computer Science (specialized in AI and IoT) is a newly formed branch that comes under the electronics and communication department, and I am the first batch student of this course. Placement is not initiated as we are currently in the second year of this course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Many facilities are provided by the department as well as the college. We can do whatever project we want to perform, and our department supports our projects and needs. Wi-Fi quality is a bit disappointing on campus, almost everyone uses 5G in college because Jio 5G has very high internet speed on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed in B.Tech CSE, which is approximately 100 to 150 students. The highest package for B.Tech CSE is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell, Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, and many more. Almost all students from the B.Tech CSE department secure jobs and internships.
content.Infrastructure: SMIT has six academic blocks, including labs, workshops, a library, and reading rooms. Besides this, it also has two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. The campus includes one ground and a sports block with a swimming facility. The hostel facilities are good, with each room accommodating two students and a floor warden assigned to each floor. The food in the mess is also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, you get good education, and can live a college life.

content.Placements: The package in our college is like 3 to 4 Lacs per year, which is an average package for a beginner, and it is good to start with it. Many companies offer here, such as HDFC, Occitan, etc. 79 percent of the students get jobs, and they get the post of human resources manager.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The college has many buildings and has a playground. All facilities are available. The hostel is also very big the hostel rooms are spacious and hygienic. There is a marina where there is good food and indoor games, a gym, etc.

admission_overview.college_name: SMIT Sikkim Admission 2025: Eligibility, Process, Courses & Fee

The institute offers8 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmesin different specialisations and fields such as Engineering, Management, Computer applications, etc., in a full-time mode. The mode ofSMIT application is online. Admission to all the courses ismerit-basedorentrance exam score-based. Apart from regular classes, SMIT offers several courses in collaboration with various institutions.
SMIT Sikkimalso provides a range of scholarships to deserving students basis their academic merit and financial needs. Further, it assists the students in obtaining a job through campus placements.

The basic eligibility to UG, PG, and doctoral courses at Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology is merit in the last qualifying examination. Admission toSMIT coursesis based on academic merit. faqs.question: How do I get into SMIT Sikkim?
faqs.answer: To get admission into SMIT Sikkim, first check the eligibility criteria for your desired course because some of the admissions are based on merit and others entrance-based. Apply online through the official website of Sikkim Manipal University. The applications are usually opened in November. Candidates are shortlisted based on scores obtained in national-level entrance exams like JEE Main, NET, CAT, or MAT. For those candidates who do not have scores from such exams, SMIT conducts its entrance exam. In addition to GDPI, an MBA aspirant has to go through Group Discussion and Personal Interview. On getting shortlisted, they have to pay the admission fee to reserve the seat.

faqs.question: I have scored 60% in Class 12. Am I eligible to get admissions into BBA course at SMIT, Sikkim Manipal University?
faqs.answer: The basic eligibility criteria required for admissions to the BBA course at SMIT, Sikkim Manipal University, is that candidates must complete their Class 12 in any stream with at least an aggregate of 50% marks. If candidates have secured 60% in their Class 12, they are eligible to enroll in the course, and there is a chance that they will get admission.However, this is not definite if the candidate has secured 60% in their Class 12, so they will definitely get admission to the BCA course. Because the admission is based on merit, and the institute offers a limited number of seats. Hence, there is a chance that candidates with higher scores will fill the seats of the BCA course.

faqs.question: Are there any govt. job opportunities that I can seek after completing a BTech from SMIT, Manipal University?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are various govt. job opportunities after completing BTech courses from SMIT, Manipal University. Government jobs remain in high demand due to various benefits, including job security, competitive pay, tax benefits, and more. Students with a bachelor's degree in technology can apply for many different jobs in the public sector. Moreover, studying a course like BTech improves a candidate's technical knowledge and analytical skills, which is necessary to crack government exams. Students with Engineering degrees can take government exams to seek research-based job opportunities at national institute. Tabulated below are some popular government job profiles for BTech graduates: SSC JE (Junior Engineer) for government infrastructure projects State Electricity Boards & Water Departments PWD and Urban Development Authorities Recruitment through GATE for companies like: BHEL (Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited) ONGC (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation) NTPC (National Thermal Power Corporation) IOCL (Indian Oil Corporation Limited) GAIL, SAIL, and BSNL

faqs.question: How are the SMIT Sikkim, Manipal University BCA placements?

Some of the points that prove the worthiness of placements are mentioned below: The college offers a lot of placement assistance. There are various companies visiting the college to recruit the students, such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, DELL, and many others. The average package offered in this course is INR 4 lakh. Placements are provided almost to everyone in top companies. The average salary package ranges from 22 LPA to 90 LPA. Students are recruited by Microsoft, Dell, Infosys, and many other big companies. Data scientist, digital marketer, and cybersecurity expert are the roles offered. Almost 75% of students get placed. In my course, 60% of the students got internships, and some of them went for higher studies. The average salary was about INR 4 lakh, and INR 8 Lacs was the highest salary offered for my course. Students are placed in Microsoft, Amazon, and IBM from our college.

reviews_list.review_title: Well-structured journalism course with strong practical training and decent campus facilities.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed from our journalism course. The highest package offered is 5.5 LPA, the lowest is 1.8 LPA, and the average package stood at 3 LPA. Top recruiters include NDTV, Dainik Bhaskar, The Indian Express, and Zee Media. Nearly 60% of students secured internships in companies like India Today, The Quint, and News18. The top roles offered are reporter, content writers, copy editor, social media executive, and digital journalism.
review_content.Infrastructure: The journalism department offers well-equipped classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, a media lab, and a resourceful library. Hostels are clean with basic amenities. The mess serves hygienic food, and the canteen offers affordable snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and students have access to sports grounds and indoor games for recreation.

individual_reviews.title: Good campus and college life, but placement rates are not that good.

content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities of the Commerce department were quite average due to frequent electricity fluctuations. The Wi-Fi facility is also quite decent as it did not provide adequate speed. The library is well-maintained with air conditioning, and borrowing is also a very easy process.

reviews.review_heading: Well-structured journalism course with strong practical training and decent campus facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College is the best in Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college was best. But one thing there was no proper drinking water. The classrooms were neat and clean but there were no ACs in the classrooms. Even in the college canteen which was very disappointing. There must be ACs in classroom and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: It has a vibrant campus life with great faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is outstanding with well-working Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, computer labs, a library, a reading hall, 6 canteens, laundry service, and a medical room. Sports department offers numerous opportunities. There are hostels for both boys and girls with good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and nice facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are too good in our college, nice classrooms with comfortable chair. Wi-Fi facilities on the campus are for teachers. Labs and library are very helpful, we spent most time in the library. Canteen food is good. Especially, samosas are very good. College is very near to bus stand. Bus availability is good.

reviews.review_heading: It’s a good college with a nice environment, making it easy to make new friends and enjoy good food.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is too good, according to the fee. Labs are also available according to their courses. Wi-Fi is available for all the students everyone can use it. The hostel is also excellent, in one room, two students staying in AC rooms are too expensive in comparison to non-AC rooms.

reviews.review_heading: All things are good in DAV College except for some conveniences in their bathrooms.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are fulfilled by the college related to Food Science and technology. The things we need to require to do experiments. Sports and games are average. There is not any big push from the authorities towards games. But the hostel and food served in it is good as well as with good hygiene canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Dav College - My experience.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, air-conditioned as well as lit rooms. It is a good department for anyone who is not comfortable going to a government college. Anyhow the food in the canteen is checked by professionals and then given to the students. There are medical facilities as well as sports facilities and a sports day is also celebrated every year.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and academics at DAV.
reviews.review_text: There is a three floor library and the classrooms are tidy and airy. We have internet access on campus. There are also projectors. The library also has computer corners, with around 20 computers. There are separate on-campus hostels, and the rooms are well-furnished. Each room also has a balcony, and there is a beauty parlor in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and supportive teachers.
reviews.review_text: The college has a hostel, food, canteen, and labs are available in the college. The benches are not in a good condition. Nails are there on the benches and the benches are clean normal safe. The quality of the food is good. Yograj Cricket Academy is there in the college. There are many alumni of this college in sports such as Neeraj Chopra, Kapil Dev, Yuvraj Singh, Manu Bhakhar and many more.

reviews.review_heading: This college is nice and I prefer this college to take admission.
reviews.review_text:
In my college, there are different buildings of hostels for boys and girls. There is also a different mess for both boys and girls. In hostel Wi-Fi facility provided by college requested by student council of college, which includes: 
President Lavish Sherawat 
Vice president Mrinal Steta
General Secretary Sourav Panwar
Joint Secretary Yaima Oiman.

reviews.review_heading: DAV College- A detailed review.
reviews.review_text: We have labs for each and everything, like psychology labs, bio labs, zoology labs, etc. We also have smart classrooms. Wi-Fi facility is provided to each and every student. The food served in the hostel is also very good. There are different sports like cricket, basketball, hockey, etc.

reviews.review_heading: DAV College, the life of youngsters.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure to be honest is pretty basic and quite old, but the canteen food is fabulous. Hostel life is pretty interesting and affordable too. College offers many places for students to chill out inside the campus. The overall environment is pretty chill.

Bangalore Institute of Technology Seats 2025

BIT offers PG courses via its campus and various affiliated colleges. Karnataka University seats vary for both on-campus and affiliated colleges. Find below the seat bifurcation for various courses offered at Bangalore Institute of Technology:
Bangalore Institute of Technology is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University. The admission process is as follows:
Step 1: Bangalore Institute of Technology Application Process 2025

BIT initiates the admission process with the application process. Aspiring candidates can download the application form from the official website. The application and entrance test fees are paid online, and candidates must attach the pay slip along with two copies of the online bank challan to the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds
Admission to UG and PG courses is entrance-based. Aspiring candidates are required to qualify for university-level or state-level entrance exams such as KCET, KMAT, PGCET, JEE Main, and COMEDK UGET.

After the completion of all selection rounds, candidates participate in the counselling process for their chosen courses. BIT releases merit lists in various rounds, with the names of selected candidates. Those finding their names on the merit list are required to pay a stipulated fee to secure their seat.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college to join for those who are studious and hardworking.
reviews.review_text: BIT has well infrastructure, including strong Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Two libraries are available, along with a digital library for students to study. Labs are fully digitalized and spacious. Classrooms are also large, with a capacity of about 60 students each and equipped with projectors. Coming to the BIT girls' hostel, I’m in love with the facilities they provide. There is Wi-Fi on all floors, the food quality is very good, and both North Indian and South Indian meals are available. Room...

reviews.review_heading: There are good placements with teachers.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. There are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library. It has a good hospitality. I do not stay in the hostel, but hostels are also pretty good. It gives good breakfast, lunch and dinner. It is ventilated. The campus is okay, but it is worth it because of placements.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty is poor and not knowledgeable. The placements are decent, but the infrastructure is bad.
reviews.review_text: There are no Wi-Fi facilities, and the quality of living is poor. The hostel is barely livable, and the classrooms are poorly maintained. Everything is dirty and not cleaned often, and the toilets are miserable. They are usable. The hostel is also just barely livable.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bangalore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The department of robotics and artificial intelligence at the Bangalore Institute of Technology has a lot of facilities and a root, which cost more than 2 crores. The faculty members are also decent, but the only problem is that the hostel will be already filled before you enter the college, so they will recommend a few PGs and hostels nearby, which cost around $10,000 per month. The BIT hostel costs 11k per month.

reviews.review_heading: My opinion on Bangalore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The network inside the college is terrible. Students cannot find a single place where they will get a good network connection. Wi-Fi present in the college is just for decoration, and nobody knows the password of it. The only place where students can get the Wi-Fi is the stationary shop present inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of faculty (C-programming) and infrastructure is short, but good facilities.
reviews.review_text: This college has better infrastructure, and also canteens are available on the campus with good quality of food. But the main disadvantage of this college is that the area of the campus is very small, and it feels congested. You can see a dental college, law college, and MBA college within 100 meters, but the college is in the city center.

reviews.review_heading: The teaching faculty is not that good, but we can expect good placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. There is Wi-Fi available, and the library is quite good. The food quality is good for lunch and dinner, but the breakfast is not always good. There are no sports and games facilities, but medical facilities are available. If there is any medical emergency, they will help out.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bangalore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: No infrastructure, no campus, no playground, and it is located in the heart of the city, and the hospital is nearby, and the medical college is also there, and the classrooms are good, the washrooms are good, and the facility is also good. Education is also good nearby; no place is there to. Visit.

reviews.review_heading: One of the Kannada Actress Sapthami Gowda who acted in KANTARA is our colleges alumni.
reviews.review_text: Our college has topnotch infrastructure, including greenery, proximity to transportation, and clean labs and classrooms. The hostel is very good and clean, and the mess and canteen provide healthy and good food. It is perfect for a student to stay in that kind of environment.

reviews.review_heading: Our institute is good at placement and providing internships for students.
reviews.review_text: BIT is one of the old institutes in Karnataka. BIT does not have good infrastructure regarding anything for our courses and coming to the hostel this does not even have good facilities but it costs high. We were not clearly not known about the infrastructure and other facilities in my college and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A college with a good crowd, decent placement, and is close to the city.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is very small. The infrastructure of the hostel is also decent. The food served is great. Robotics and artificial intelligence is located on the 6th floor of the new mechanical building which is a new building of BIT. The hostel is located next to the campus and is easily accessible.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college to join in Banglore city.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is excellent with spacious labs and large classrooms equipped with projectors. The labs are well-equipped with internet access and a good number of systems. Hostel is clean and maintained well. Rooms are also clean. Food served is good. College offers sports facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: BIT is the oldest college with high placement and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: The lab is fully developed with new equipment, and the classrooms are clean and hygienic. The infrastructure of the college is quite less because it's an old school, but still, the campus is good. The quality of the food is good, and there are 3 canteens available.

reviews.review_heading: Bangalore Institute of Technology: Know the Truth.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are adjustable, and classrooms can accommodate 60-70 students. Wi-Fi is available but slow in speed. Labs are well-maintained. There are 3 libraries, which is enough. Talking about hostel food, it is far better than any PG. Rooms and washrooms require adjustment.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Labs were well-equipped, food is good in the canteen. I have no idea about the hostel and mess food. A certain amount of support is provided by the college towards sports and games. Since there is a hospital next to the college, no worries about medical issues. The college has first aid provided on every floor.

review_summary.college_name: Marwadi University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is good. There is a lot of freedom. I mean no boundaries for girls and boys.

content.Placements: 10 percent of students get here. The highest package offered is 48 LPA. Companies like Capgemini, Wipro, and TCS hire students. The average salary package offered ranges from 6-8 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3 or 3.5 LPA. Students get internships in companies like Infosys, HDFC Bank, Samsung, Asian Paints, Nestled and Flipkart. Our college has more than 3,000 internships.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in our hostel rooms and libraries, but not in classrooms, as it is a place where we have to listen to classes. The campus is modern, spacious, and lush green in an open space. Our university has a well-stocked library, and we also have a record in the library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure is good, facilities are available at any college time.

content.Placements: 60 percentage of students can be placed in our course. The highest package is 12 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Top recruiters are Flipkart, Amazon, etc. 20 percentage of students got internships in our course in Infosys, Amazon. Top roles offered are artificial Intelligence engineers and machine learning engineers.
content.Infrastructure: Well-regarded for its modern facilities, labs, seminar halls, and good Wi-Fi. Classrooms are very good and the most beautiful thing in this college is the library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is good, and all the food which we have is very tasty. The mess and canteen, medical facilities are good, and sports and games are very few.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - PBL) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure is good, facilities are available at any college time.

content.Placements: 75 percent of students are placed in 2023. The highest package is 34.50 LPA, and the lowest package is 5 LPA. The list of recruiters includes Amazon, TCS, Cognizant, Capgemini, and many others. 40 percent of students got internships in Infosys, Amazon, and others. .
content.Infrastructure: In Marwadi University, the facilities are well maintained, and the staff is well trained and educated. The library is very good. Classrooms and labs are excellent, and the overall infrastructure is excellent. Hostel facilities are good, and wardens are very helpful. If there is any issue, they respond immediately. Mess, canteen, and medical facilities are also good.

individual_reviews.user_name: Devi Veera Venkata Sai Ram Tamma
individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Robotics and Automation) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the university is good.

content.Placements: More than 80% of students get placed. The packages range from 3 LPA to 7 LPA. Companies like Honda, Bosch, Adani, and Toyota hire students. Many students get placement in core companies. This R&A course started in 2025, but the offers are good.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and other facilities are all perfect. Sometimes, you may face network problems. Sports and games, as well as medical facilities, are good. In the hostel, the main C-block rooms and washrooms are unhygienic. Food is also good. Only vegetarian options in the mess, but non-vegetarian food is available at one center of the university.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, modern infrastructure, and good placement with an industry-ready curriculum.

content.Placements: In our course, the overall placement record has been quite impressive, with nearly 85%-90% of the students from the recent passing out batch securing jobs. The highest package offered is around 44 LPA, and the average package ranges between 6 LPA-7 LPA. The roles offered are diverse, ranging from software engineering, data analyst, VLSI design, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department are well-developed to support both academic and practical learning. The Classrooms have smart board projectors and Wi-Fi connectivity, ensuring an interactive teaching environment. The campus has good medical facilities with a health center, and the college has excellent sports and games infrastructure.

Below is the step-wise detailed admission process of Marwadi University:
Step 1: Application Process

Candidates based on valid scores in various exams accepted by the college will be shortlisted for admission rounds based on the programmes the candidate applied for.

paragraphs: The admission process in Symbiosis Institute of Digital and Telecom Management (SIDTM), Pune invlolves online registration, entrance exam, selection process and confirmation of admission.Applicants should comply with the requirements set by the organization and do well in every testing procedure.Details of SIDTM Pune admissions are given below step-wise:
STEP 1: SIDTM Pune Application Process 2025

The applicants should apply to the SIDTM Pune through their official website and fill out the online application form.To get started, they will need to apply and take the SNAP entrance examination, submit necessary academic papers and hand in the application fee.
STEP 2: Selection

Applicants are shortlisted based onSNAP scores, followed by participation inGroup Exercise (GE), Personal Interview (PI), and Written Ability Test (WAT). The final selection is merit-based and considers performance in all these components. No separate written test is conducted apart from SNAP.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

The offer letter is sent to shortlisted candidates who are expected to have confirmed their place by paying the first semesterSIDTM fee.When the fees are paid and the documents checked, the seat is now confirmed in the corresponding specialisation of SIDTM MBA.

individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: Overall, the course had variety but diverged into niche research and strategy side. Well about placement the college had good contacts. Department tried to bring various companies to college for benefit of the students. A lot of companies carry out campus drive in our college for different branches. individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: Lot of companies meet this college. According to their criteria, students get selected for the job. Before 2-3 days two companies came to this college and 17 students were selected for the placements. Companies like Infosys, Tech Mahindra, etc., came to the college.

They gave sufficient time to resolve queries as SELMA provided best examples to understand the topics and most guiding when was in internships. They were always ready to cope with the hectic schedule and even assisted us whenever they were out of the station over the phone. Faculty members were super awesome and very much dedicated. Some of the teachers make you love the subject which they teach. It was too useful but a little bit lengthy with vast knowledge comprised of all fields such as marketing human resource, finance, and law contacts as well as detailed study tours with reputed firms and all collaborated project internships in the company to be finished in the last semester. The course impacted our future success in how we completed with knowledge and experience and really helpful.

reviews.review_text: Cultural activities were good in the college. When it comes to the hostel, the food was average, and the infrastructure was good. The classrooms, library, and canteen were very near the blocks and good. They allow sports in cultural activities only, but not for the leisure period in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied because of the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has diverse courses with good facilities like labs, a library, and sports, on a large green campus. Its hostels provide basic furniture (bed, table, cupboard) with options for AC/non-AC, Wi-Fi. There are separate messes, though the food quality receives mixed reviews, emphasising affordability and central location.

reviews.review_text: The facilities and their infrastructure of our course are beautiful and more attractive, and the Wi-Fi signal is good. The labs have excellent equipment, and the classrooms are clean and good. The libraries are filled with knowledge books and technology books, and the games and sports are conducted by the college management.

reviews.review_heading: It is really good to join because of the friendly faculty.

Every class has digital boards, and the libraries are filled with technology books and knowledge books. The facilities of the hostel are really good and peaceful for students, and the quality of food in the hostel is really good and tasty. The medical facilities are really great, and the sports and games are organized by our col...

Food availability in the mess is too good and tasty and medical facilities are really excellent and take care of students. The main thing that college management encourages the students for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. The library is available at our college. The hostel is good, but the food served is not good. The canteen and medical facilities are available. There are separate boys’ hostel and girls’ hostel. Sports are not available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is wonderful with a vast amount of space and greenery, well-built infrastructure, and a Wi-Fi-surrounded campus. The library is technologically advanced, provided with systems with the internet along with books. The quality of food in the college hostel is decent with a healthy menu. In adequate times, sports are conducted mainly in festive seasons.

reviews.review_heading: I hope it improves for next year's students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are not so good, and not so bad. It is average. Classroom infrastructure is good. The college has two libraries that provide textbooks. There are canteens, and mess food is good. Sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: A review of my college about the courses, placements, and cultural events.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is very neat and good. They design the curriculum according to the respective departments to enhance student productivity. They provide hostels with different types of rooms for both Indian and international students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with placements in 2025 and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi speed is not very fast. In the hostel, there are only two routers per floor. There is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. The overall infrastructure is better compared to other colleges. The hostel food is not very good.

reviews.review_heading: It will become a university in 2025, and it is attracting companies to hire the students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good, it has a greenery college and it is very pleasant, full of trees. Wi-Fi facilities are also available, and labs are very attractive to get interested in doing work. Classrooms are very good and the library contains lots of programming and core subjects books which can be used to score marks and crack interviews.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Godavari Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, not bad, but the food quality in the hostel is not good. The mess food is acceptable, and the infrastructure is good, but the hostel rooms are not very good. The library is centrally air-conditioned, and the Wi-Fi signal is okay. The quality of food is not too good in this college, and medical facilities are available 24/7, with a hospital very near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Not good and not bad depends up
reviews.review_text: 1st-year campus is nice, but the 2nd-year campus is not that good looking because of old boards, classrooms, and benches. When it comes to the electronics lab, some kits will work, some won't, but the faculty will teach you how to do it with that kit.

reviews.review_heading: Godavari Institute of Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in my course/department are above average. Classes are good and the lab is well-equipped. The library spans almost two floors, and we can see one canteen per block. Every working alternative day has one sports period.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally disappointed with this college regarding placements, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also too poor. When you start from labs to washrooms, nothing is in a proper way. Especially in our course, there is no proper laboratory equipment for study. I had asked my friends about the food in the mess, and they said it is below average.

overview_faqs.question: Is ITM Vocational University UGC approved?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, ITM Vocational University is UGC- University Grant Commision approved. The University was established in 2014 and is a part of ITM Group, a known educational conglomerate. It is one of the renowned vocational universities in India. The University is a member of the AIU - Association of Indian Universities. Further, the University has collaborated with Herzing University-USA, RMIT University-Australia, University of Wolverhampton-UK and University of Denver-USA for the student exchange programme. It has collaborated with FGI to organise workshops, seminars and conferences.

Sant Kabir College Ahmedabad offers two full-time PGDM programmes. First is PGDM with dual specialisations and second is PGDM in Applied Finance. The course is divided into 6 trimesters spread over a duration of 2 years. Students opting for PGDM with dual specialisation can choose from the following specialisations:
Eligibility criteria for PGDM: Students who have a bachelor's degree in a minimum three-year programme in any discipline with a minimum of 50% (45% for SC/ST/OBC) from any university, recognized by (AIU)/ AICTE/ UGC. Students must have a valid score of CAT/ CMAT/ XAT/ MAT/ ATMA/ GMAT or state-level selection test, if any conducted by the respective state regime. SKIPS Ahmedabad PGDM fees are approx INR 5.5 lakh - INR 6.6 lakh. The same is payable in 4 different instalments during the complete course duration.
The second course is PGDM in Applied Finance, which is a biennial full-time programme. The course curriculum has been curated by a specialised team of industry experts. The programme aims to provide high managerial talent and skill-set to the students. PGDM in Applied Finance is specially designed for candidates who aim to pursue a career in business valuation, financial analytics, wealth management, international finance & accounting, and BFSI.

review_summary.college_name: Brainware University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Learning and growing at Brainware University.

content.Placements: Our college has a placement rate of 98 percent. An average package ranges from 3.5 LPA to 3.8 LPA. I am a 2nd year student, so I haven't been placed yet, but as I have seen my seniors, they are definitely well placed. In 2024-2025, the highest package was 36 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is compact and homely. There are a total of 8 buildings currently, and everyone has its own name. The law department is in the UB-VI. Every classroom is well-equipped with AC, projectors, benches, whiteboards, and dustbins. We also have a departmental library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good learning environment for tech students.

content.Placements: The campus has a good atmosphere, regular classes, and proper guidance, coding, and research work. Students can build a strong career here. 98 percent placement record in our course. Top recruiting companies are like IBM, Kargil, Infosys, etc. A maximum of students get internships from the 3rd year to the 4th year. The highest package offered in our college is 28 LPA. The lowest is 8 LPA. Overall, a good campus for placement and the environment.
content.Infrastructure: The department has multiple computer labs with updated systems, Python setup, DBMS tools, and AI/ML software support. Labs are air-conditioned and properly ventilated. Smart classrooms with projectors, clean seating, and good ventilation. Most classes are held in UB-IV and UB-V in our course. In the college canteen the food is good. A wide variety is available in our canteen, Indian, Chinese, South, etc. The hostel is also a very good, very friendly, and ragging-free hostel, very supportive.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Animation and Multimedia - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college has an industry-focused multimedia program with an active campus life.

content.Placements: The B.Sc. multimedia program at Brainware University offers strong practical training. Our batch sees nearly 90% placement. Packages range from 2–9 LPA depending on skill level and portfolio. A good number of students receive internships in media and production organizations, and roles like Graphic Designer, Animator, and VFX Artist are frequently offered.
content.Infrastructure: Our course has functional multimedia labs, steady Wi-Fi, and classrooms for practical sessions. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, though the food quality is moderate. The campus has basic medical support and good sports areas for cricket, football, and indoor games, which add to student life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college. It should be a little bit lenient regarding attendance.

content.Placements: Almost 80-90% of students are being placed, with the highest being 20-24 LPA, moderate 5-6 LPA, and the lowest 2-3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are: Serum Institute of India, Sun Pharma, Biocon, and Reliance Life Sciences. 70-80% of students get internship offers. Roles include lab assistant, professor, food safety officer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi. Clean lab structure, neat classrooms, and a pin-drop silent library. The quality of food in the hostel is average, and in the canteen, it was not that good earlier, but now it has been improved. Medical facilities include clinics, and different sports and games keep happening.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Decent academics and infrastructure with scope for better industry links.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students were placed. The highest may be 27 LPA, and the average is 5-6 LPA. The lowest is 2-3 LPA. Some top recruiting or visiting companies for biotech students reported include Novo Nordisk and Alembic Pharmaceuticals. 92% of students got placed. Placements show some individual students placed at companies like Cipla, TCS, and Novo Nordisk.
content.Infrastructure: Our biotech department has well-equipped labs for microbiology, biochemistry, cell biology, animal biotechnology, and cell culture, along with smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and library access with good reference books. Hostel facilities provide basic but decent rooms. Mess and canteen food are average but hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Learning and growing at Brainware University.
reviews.review_text: The campus is compact and homely. There are a total of 8 buildings currently, and everyone has its own name. The law department is in the UB-VI. Every classroom is well-equipped with AC, projectors, benches, whiteboards, and dustbins. We also have a departmental library.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment for tech students.
reviews.review_text: The department has multiple computer labs with updated systems, Python setup, DBMS tools, and AI/ML software support. Labs are air-conditioned and properly ventilated. Smart classrooms with projectors, clean seating, and good ventilation. Most classes are held in UB-IV and UB-V in our course. In the college canteen the food is good. A wide variety is available in our canteen, Indian, Chinese, South, etc. The hostel is also a very good, very friendly, and ragging-free hostel, very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: The college has an industry-focused multimedia program with an active campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our course has functional multimedia labs, steady Wi-Fi, and classrooms for practical sessions. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, though the food quality is moderate. The campus has basic medical support and good sports areas for cricket, football, and indoor games, which add to student life.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college. It should be a little bit lenient regarding attendance.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi. Clean lab structure, neat classrooms, and a pin-drop silent library. The quality of food in the hostel is average, and in the canteen, it was not that good earlier, but now it has been improved. Medical facilities include clinics, and different sports and games keep happening.

reviews.review_heading: Decent academics and infrastructure with scope for better industry links.
reviews.review_text: Our biotech department has well-equipped labs for microbiology, biochemistry, cell biology, animal biotechnology, and cell culture, along with smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and library access with good reference books. Hostel facilities provide basic but decent rooms. Mess and canteen food are average but hygienic.

admission_overview.college_name: Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University Admission 2025: Eligibility, Fee, Application & Selection

paragraphs: Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women’s University admissionsare both merit or entrance-based. The university offers admission direct based on merit, through the university cum scholarship exam or via scholarship exam. JVWU conducts theJNEE or Joint National Entrance Examination,for regular courses.

Candidates can also get admission through Management/ NRI Quota.JVWUoffers UG, PG, and diploma courses in multiple streams, such as Arts, Science, Management, etc. The university also offers UG and PG courses in distance education. Interested candidates can apply for admission online.

Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women’s University usually begins admission inFebruary. Candidates can fill out the application form on the official website of the university. Find below the keyJVWU admissionhighlights:
Particulars
JVWU Admission Highlights 2025
Mode of study
Programmes Offered
Admission status 2025
Ongoing:UG, PG & Diploma
How to apply?
https://jvwu.ac.in/
Level of programmes offered
Popular programmes

JVWU offers more than 50 courses at UG, PG and diploma levels. The basic eligibility for UG courses is Class 12 whereas graduation is required to apply for PG programmes. The university offers direct merit-based admission to some of the UG and PG courses. Besides, JVWU also considers scores of the candidates in national, state or university-level entrance exams. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria for topJVWU courses:

JVWU admission processbegins with registration via online mode. Candidates need to select their preferred mode of admission while filling out the application form. Below are step-wise admission details for JVWU:
STEP 1: JVWU Application Process 2025

The mode of application is both online and offline. The offline forms are attached in the prospectus. Aspirants need to pay an application fee ofINR 1,000for regular courses. The registration fee isINR 3,000for research programmes. Candidates need to pay the fee via any of the online payment modes. Besides, aspirants can also collect the form offline.
STEP 2: Selection

Once registered, candidates are selected based on their mode of admission. During application, candidates need to select whether they want direct merit-based admission, through Management Quota, University scholarship exam orJNEEexam. The university conducts a Joint National Entrance Examination for admission to some of the UG and PG specialisations. For some of the courses, the university may also conduct a personal interview round for selection.
STEP 3: Merit List & Counselling

The university releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates. Besides, aspirants must come for counselling and document verification. Aspirants applying for BAMS or BHMS need to participate in NEET Counselling. Selected candidates need to pay theJVWU feeto confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: How are B.Tech placements at JVWU, Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The B.Tech placements at Jaipur's Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University (JVWU) have shown a lot of promise. Now, let's get specific: The JVWU Training and Placement Cell guarantees graduating students 100% placement assistance in addition to giving them a platform to explore, refine, and confront corporate challenges with confidence. Giving women the chance to manage their own finances is how they see empowerment. Highlights of the Placement: About 50–60% of B.Tech students enrolled in different programs are placed. For both B.Tech programs in food engineering and computer science, the median package is about 4.35 LPA. At 12 LPA, the highest package available is the lowest, at about 2.5 LPA.

faqs.question: How are B.Tech placements at JVWU?
faqs.answer: The placements of JVWU are decent enough. The median package of B.Tech in both computer Science and food engineering is INR4.35 LPA, the highest package offered is INR12 LPA and lowest package is INR2.5 LPA. The placements ratio is also nearly 50%. Overall the placemnts are decent. Duration 4 years (Full Time) Course Level UG Degree Total Tuition Fees INR 3.20 Lakh Type of University Private Year of establishment 2008 Placements: Around 50%-60% of the students from our course were placed. The salary package offered varies from 2.0 LPA to 4.5 LPA. Tata, IBM, Microsoft, Reliance, and Genus are some top recruiting companies for our course. Students got placed in prestigious companies with the highest salary package of 6.50 LPA and the lowest salary package of 1.53 LPA. Around 50%-60% of the students got placed in Tata Consultancy Services, while 20%-30% of the students got placed in Intecons Software Lab and many more. Almost 50%-60% of the students are placed in every year. Students are offered roles like software tester, data scientist, data administrator, software engineer, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Best campus for girls. Completely safe and peaceful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is the best. Classrooms, labs, library, activity rooms, etc., are fully furnished, neat, and clean. Hostel facilities are also available, which are also very good. Washrooms are totally clean and hygienic. As for the mess, the meals are good and tasty. Proper hygiene is maintained in the mess as well.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was good. There was a lack of modern techniques of teaching like lack of digital classes, presentation, and so on. The hostel was also amazing, and we got the facility of Wi-Fi. Phones were not allowed, so I think that's why we were more indulged in our studies. Food served was also good.

For medical facilities we are having here homeopathy, ayurveda and allopathy hospitals.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the facilities and infrastructure. Teaching facilities are good.

Facilities were good like hostel classrooms library medical sports and games. Campus was good overall 
Also there was facility of bank inside the campus and also discotheque and gym for entertainment purpose. Overall everything was good. Music room was there and teachers for every field like sports teacher and gym.

reviews.review_heading: Jayoti Vidhyapeeth Women's University is very good for girls.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. All the facilities are available in our college. Wi-Fi facilities are available. Labs are very good. Classrooms have projectors. Medical facilities are available as they are very important. Games and sports classes are conducted every day.

reviews.review_heading: The college life is a mixture of fun and studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is too good. The college provides high-speed Wi-Fi and smart classrooms. Everything is good here, but the food served in the canteen is a little expensive. I suggest the college to focus on food prices.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best private women's university in India. The campus is great.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement, good infrastructure (not as good as other colleges).

review_content.Placements: Around 70% students, who were eligible to sit in placements, got placed last year. The highest package is around 50 LPA, and the lowest can be expected as 3 LPA-4 LPA. The off-campus placement has even offered a 1 crore per annum package to a student. Internships are offered only to CSE students most of the time. However, the average stipend is around Rs. 30,000, but not all the students get internships on campus. The role you get solely depends on your skill level and your interview.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college does not have a huge campus area, but it is fine. Washrooms, rooms, ground, and labs are cleaned, proper lighting, AC rooms, titles over the floor and walls. Wi-Fi works well, the library is also well-maintained, and different types of books are available. However, the condition of the hostel is not very good, as the building is old, but the management tries to do everything to make it comfortable for the students. Mess food is also fine, the canteen menu is not too lengthy, but momos and spring rolls are tasty for sure.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Reviewing my college IGDTUW.

review_content.Placements: The placement is very good here, and many companies visit this college. Even before placement, all the companies visit this college to guide students and help them to prepare for the interview and the selection process, and it is called pre-placement talks, which definitely gives college students an edge over those students who are appearing from outside the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel is average. They provide basics like AC, decent food, decent water to drink, and basic rooms are small, washing machines are 2 per washroom, but not all of them work, but some do, which teaches you patience. The hostel timings are very strict. You have to be in the hostel till 8:00 PM, but if you want to go to the college computer lab, then you can stay there till 11:00 PM.

review_summary.college_name: IGDTUW Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My college campus is small but beautiful, and the placement is very good.

content.Placements: 70-75 percent of students are placed in my college. The highest placement of my branch is 1 crore, and the lowest is 6-8 LPA. Because it's a women's college, so the companies that require women for completion of ratio come to my college, so many big companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft visit my college.
content.Infrastructure: My college is very small, but beautiful. Wi-Fi condition is okay. Classroom condition is also okay. The library is very good. The hostel provides me with facilities like a freezer and an oven. The canteen is small, but the food tastes good. Medical facilities are good, and sports and games are okay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My own IGDTUW experience.

content.Placements: Almost 70%-80% of students are placed in internships for the third year. The top roles offered are SDE intern, Adapt intern, etc. Top recruiting companies are Wells Fargo and ServiceNow. The highest package, I guess, is 1.5 LPA for an intern, Rs. 45,000 minimum.
content.Infrastructure: There is a Wi-Fi connection, and it works well. Overall, the classrooms are decent and air-conditioned, and the library is also pretty good. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. They provide medical facilities, a mess, and everything. My favourite spot is the library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placement, good infrastructure (not as good as other colleges).

content.Placements: Around 70% students, who were eligible to sit in placements, got placed last year. The highest package is around 50 LPA, and the lowest can be expected as 3 LPA-4 LPA. The off-campus placement has even offered a 1 crore per annum package to a student. Internships are offered only to CSE students most of the time. However, the average stipend is around Rs. 30,000, but not all the students get internships on campus. The role you get solely depends on your skill level and your interview.
content.Infrastructure: The college does not have a huge campus area, but it is fine. Washrooms, rooms, ground, and labs are cleaned, proper lighting, AC rooms, titles over the floor and walls. Wi-Fi works well, the library is also well-maintained, and different types of books are available. However, the condition of the hostel is not very good, as the building is old, but the management tries to do everything to make it comfortable for the students. Mess food is also fine, the canteen menu is not too lengthy, but momos and spring rolls are tasty for sure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Reviewing my college IGDTUW.

content.Placements: The placement is very good here, and many companies visit this college. Even before placement, all the companies visit this college to guide students and help them to prepare for the interview and the selection process, and it is called pre-placement talks, which definitely gives college students an edge over those students who are appearing from outside the college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is average. They provide basics like AC, decent food, decent water to drink, and basic rooms are small, washing machines are 2 per washroom, but not all of them work, but some do, which teaches you patience. The hostel timings are very strict. You have to be in the hostel till 8:00 PM, but if you want to go to the college computer lab, then you can stay there till 11:00 PM.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: IGDTUW offers a balanced college experience with scope to grow if you use opportunities well.

content.Placements: For batch 2024, B.Tech CSE at IGDTUW, 77% of students got placed, with the highest package of 56 LPA, and the average package is 25.15 LPA. Internships are secured by most third & fourth-year students via companies like Microsoft, Adobe, JP Morgan, etc., with roles mostly in software dev, backed, cloud, and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: IGDTUW has decent Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel is basic with average mess food, the canteen is okay, medical help is limited, and sports facilities exist but need better upkeep. Overall, the infrastructure is functional but not exceptional.

paragraphs: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW)admission 2025is PG courses will open soon. Candidates can visit the official website to enquire about the admission procedure. Btecg and BArch admission/ counselling throughJoint Admission Committee (JAC)is ongoing for 2025.GDTUWis awomen-only technical universitythat offers technical and management courses. Some of the popular courses offered by the certified university are BTech, BBA, MBA, MCA, BArch, etc.IGDTUWadmission to the offered courses is based onnational-level entrance exams. The university also offers PhD in direct and regular mode. Moreover, candidates shall check the eligibility conditions for the course before the form is filled out.

IGDTUW eligibility for the UG and PG programmes is mainly the last qualifying exam candidates have passed. As per the university's admission guidelines, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria of the course and also the selection criteria. Candidates willing to take admission at IGDTUW must complete the admission process as per the university's admission guidelines. IGDTUW admission process is a multi-step process which is different for every other course. Candidates must make sure to read carefully the admission process for their desired course. Find below the IGTUW admission process for 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Candidates must first register themselves to begin the application process. BTech/BArch programme's admission is done via the Joint Admission Counseling (JAC). Therefore candidates must visit the official website of JAC and register there by providing all the required details. For, BBA/ MBA candidates must apply through CMAC's official website. Further, for the rest PG and PhD programme candidates must apply via the IGTUW's official website.
Step 2: Selection Process

Candidate's applications are scrutinised for the selection process. For, BTech JEE Main's score is considered for selection and BBA/BArch programme's selection is done based on the last qualifying exam.MAT, CAT, and GATEexams are considered for the MBA/MTech/MPlan programme selection. For MCA the selection is done based onCUETconducted by the university and finally for the PhD selection is done based on theXAT RATfollowed by an interview.
Step 3: Merit list/Seat allotment

UG candidates must register for the JAC counselling for seat allotment. Based on the selection process the university releases a provisional list with candidates' names who have qualified for the selection round.
Step 4: Final selection
Once steps 1, 2, and 3 are completed seats are allotted as per the admission/ counselling bodies. Candidates must pay the admission fee to confirm the seat.

placement_data.title: IGDTUW Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: IGDTUW has a placement cell that is responsible for securing lucrative career opportunities for students. The institute invites companies from different sectors to conduct the placement process at the Campus premises.

As per the latest report, IGDTUW recorded 69.3% placements for the Class of 2024. A total of 135 recruiters participated during the IGDTUW placement in 2024 and placed 537 students of the 2024 batch. The participating recruiters placed 56 CSE AI students, 145 CSE, 125 IT, 95 ECE and 64 MAE students of the BTech batch 2024. Additionally, the MCA batch 2024 consists of 74 students, of whom 49 were placed with handsome packages. The highest and average package offered to the BTech CSE batch 2024 stood at INR 56 LPA and INR 25.15 LPA , respectively. Further, the highest and average package offered to the MCA students during IGDTUW placements 2024 stood at INR 52.89 LPA and INR 14.13 LPA , respectively.

Apart from offering placement opportunities, IGDTUW also offers internship opportunities to the students of the Class 2024. According to the report, 427 students received internship offers from reputed organizations. The top recruiters who participated during IGDTUW placement in 2024 included Google, Adobe, Palo Alto, Microsoft, Uber, Atlassian, BNY Mellon, Deloitte, JP Morgan, Cisco, PWC, Salesforce, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, British Telecom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: My college campus is small but beautiful, and the placement is very good.
reviews.review_text: My college is very small, but beautiful. Wi-Fi condition is okay. Classroom condition is also okay. The library is very good. The hostel provides me with facilities like a freezer and an oven. The canteen is small, but the food tastes good. Medical facilities are good, and sports and games are okay.

reviews.review_heading: My own IGDTUW experience.
reviews.review_text: There is a Wi-Fi connection, and it works well. Overall, the classrooms are decent and air-conditioned, and the library is also pretty good. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. They provide medical facilities, a mess, and everything. My favourite spot is the library.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement, good infrastructure (not as good as other colleges).
reviews.review_text: The college does not have a huge campus area, but it is fine. Washrooms, rooms, ground, and labs are cleaned, proper lighting, AC rooms, titles over the floor and walls. Wi-Fi works well, the library is also well-maintained, and different types of books are available. However, the condition of the hostel is not very good, as the building is old, but the management tries to do everything to make it comfortable for the students. Mess food is also fine, the canteen menu is not too lengthy, but momo...

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing my college IGDTUW.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. They provide basics like AC, decent food, decent water to drink, and basic rooms are small, washing machines are 2 per washroom, but not all of them work, but some do, which teaches you patience. The hostel timings are very strict. You have to be in the hostel till 8:00 PM, but if you want to go to the college computer lab, then you can stay there till 11:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: IGDTUW offers a balanced college experience with scope to grow if you use opportunities well.
reviews.review_text: IGDTUW has decent Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel is basic with average mess food, the canteen is okay, medical help is limited, and sports facilities exist but need better upkeep. Overall, the infrastructure is functional but not exceptional.

reviews.review_heading: College has good placements with a decent curriculum. But the infrastructure needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at IGDTUW is satisfactory but has scope for improvement. Wi-Fi works well in the academic blocks but is inconsistent in hostels and some areas. Labs are functional but could be better equipped. Classrooms in ECE and CSE generally lack air-conditioning, which can be challenging during peak summers. Library provides good resources but often falls short on seating capacity during exams. Campus has a spacious ground for sports and activities. Although I haven't stayed in the hostel, f...

reviews.review_heading: If you want placement then definitely go for it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is like average because only few classes have AC in them. The campus is very small. Hostel is not good at all. Lab classes have AC but others are non-AC. But in 2025 IT block will have AC in all the rooms in which the classes for CS, AI, IT, and AIML take place.

reviews.review_heading: Great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. You don't need to walk a lot to get to your classes like other colleges. Facilities are not up to expectations. You don't have a proper seating arrangement to have your food in the canteen. We do have Nescafé where you can enjoy yourself. The campus is shared by the students of Dr B. R. Ambedkar. The sports societies are active. Most of the computers don't work in the labs, and the library gets crowded most of the time.

reviews.review_heading: Good exposure and opportunities, a supportive environment, and improving placements.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of IGDTUW is average. Wi-Fi is available across the campus but not always reliable. Labs are equipped for basic requirements, though some equipment is outdated. Classrooms are spacious with projectors. The library is useful with good resources. Hostel facilities are manageable, with rooms of decent size and average cleanliness. The mess food is also average, sometimes good, sometimes just okay, with better options available in the canteen. Medical facilities are basic....

reviews.review_heading: Strong placement and supportive faculty, but infrastructure needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the institute is below average when compared to the top government colleges in India. The library often remains overcrowded making it difficult for students to study comfortably. Classrooms are not fully centralized. In addition, Wi-Fi connectivity is restricted to only a few specific labs, limiting accessibility across the campus. The quality of hostel food also falls short of expectations and requires significant improvement.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and campus.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the campus is well maintained and student friendly. The academic facilities include spacious classrooms with modern teaching aids, fully equipped labs and well stocked library with access to online journals. Hostel facilities are quite comfortable providing all the basic needs. The mess food is hygienic and offers a variety of food.

reviews.review_heading: I am truly satisfied with my faculty, college life, friends, and the new experiences I have gained.
reviews.review_text: The IT department is newly built and has smart boards in almost every class. Wi-Fi can only be accessed on the 1st floor of IT and the library. Classrooms are good and spacious, but still sometimes congested. The library is well-managed and has lots of books related to our course. I am not a hosteler, so I don't know about it.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, this college is really good.
reviews.review_text: They have AC only in the IT department and in labs. Food quality is average, like any other college. Hostel is not that good, they provide AC only to 1st years, plus you have bunkers bed in first year, like 6 people sharing a room for AC. In others, there are triple, so overall hostel is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are nice, only two students have to share the room. 24/7 Wi-Fi facility in the hostel, as well as water and electricity facility, is also minimal. The hostel mess food is also good and hygienic as it is checked every weekend, and there are timing restrictions from 9:00 PM onwards, nobody is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement in 2025 and in the ECE-AI department. Infrastructure should be improved.
reviews.review_text: The ECE-AI department at IGDTUW has an average environment. They provide good and well-equipped labs with Wi-Fi facilities. There is a decent library. Some facilities are a bit outdated. I'm a day scholar, but one of my best friend is a hosteller, she told me about hostel that it is just poor, like the food is so bad and tasteless, rooms are so small, and the rules and regulations are so strict. The medical facilities available are below average. The classrooms are not fully air-conditioned in E...

college_info.intro:
The flagship course at CMR Centre for Business Studies is the MBA program. The course provides students with a solid Management foundation. The course is offered in various specializations. The CMR CBS MBA program is offered in dual specializations like Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Banking, Finance & Insurance Services Management, Healthcare Management, Startups & SMEs Management, among others. The curriculum is imparted through a mixed method of classroom teaching and in-house/guest lectures.
Further information on CMR Centre for Business Studies popular programs can be found below:

fees_and_eligibility.overview: At the PG level, CMR Center for Business Studies offers a diverse range of progammes. Candidates can choose Full Time courses, from stream like Business & Management Studies. College offers MBA/PGDM courses at the PG level.

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, you may get into CMR Centre for Business Studies with 85% in graduation, provided that you meet the other selection criteria as well. The minimum percentage required to apply for the MBA course offered by CMR Centre for Business Studies is 50% (45% for reserved category). However, as admissions are entrance-based, securing the percentage is not enough. Students also need to provide scores secured in accepted entrance tests.

review_content.Placements: The placements are very good. Nearly 90% of students got placed. The top recruiting companies are good. They provide very good opportunities for students with good salary packages.
review_content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are good. The canteen food and hostel facilities are good and clean. The food is good. A library is available with all kinds of books required. The classrooms are good with all the required facilities.
review_content.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and supportive. Semester exams are good. The passing percentage is good. Exams are conducted well. The faculty encourage us very well. They provide opportunities for students to learn from campus activities.

review_content.Placements: Almost 40% of the students were placed through campus. The highest salary offered was Rs. 35,000 per month. The lowest salary offered was Rs. 18,000 per month. The average salary offered would be Rs. 25,000 per month. Companies like EY, Deloitte, and Oracle, are the top recruiters of our college. Students were offered with roles like associate and entry-level. In our course, the salary package offered ranges from 4- 5 LPA. Almost 75% of the students got an internship. Every year, there is a growth in placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: CMR Center for Business Studies is a college which has opened many minds and cultivated them to be a better citizen in the society through their teaching, motivating as well as inspiring students.
