faqs.question: Can I join CMR Centre for Business Studies without MAT for MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can join MBA programme of the CMR Centre for Business Studies without MAT scores. The institute can be accessed through national level test scores of CAT, XAT, CMAT, GMAT, KMAT and PGCET. A candidate must have of at least a Bachelor degree obtained with at least 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST/Cat- I Karnataka candidates) and must have appeared for any of these recognisable entrance tests mentioned above. .

faqs.question: What is the admission process for CMR Centre for Business Studies?
faqs.answer: CMR Centre for Business Studies's admission processis fairly simple. Students seeking to get into the college need to first meet the preset eligiibility requirements. Those who meet the eligibility requirements can follow the steps listed below to complete the process:Step 1: Register for the course by filling out the application.Step 2: Go through the selection rounds and get shortlisted.Step 3: Pay the admission fees for seat confirmation.

faqs.answer: No, CMR Centre for Business Studies does not accept direct admissions for its MBA course. Hence, no, CMR Centre for Business Studies admissions are not offered directly.

courses_data.name: Atlas SkillTech University, School of Management and Entrepreneurship BBA Admission 2026
courses_data.description: Atlas SkillTech University, School of Management and Entrepreneurship BBAis a three year course offered in regular and full time mode. Students have an option of choosing to pursue BBA for four years, in which case, they will be awarded the degree of BBA (Hons). The minimum eligibility for the programes is passing Class 12 from a recognised Board of Education with atleast 50% aggregate score. The institute also conducts its own assessment, theBusiness Aptitude Testas part of its admission process. Selection Criteria is entrance based. Candidates will also have to appear for a Group Discussion and a Personal Interview after clearing the BAT. Hereafter, Selected Candidate must also appear for a Collaborative Acceleration round. Collaborative Acceleratoris a group activity that is designed to have deeper insights about the collaboration, communication and leadership style of the candidate. reviews.review_heading: Life at Atlas: Innovation and insight.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with projectors, high-speed Wi-Fi, and interactive learning. The library offers a good collection of academic books, journals, resources, etc. Research databases are also easily accessible to students. Students have access to computer labs for research, work, studies, etc. The best quality food is available at the hostel. It has an Equinox business park, where the university has located a turf for cricket and football, and where the university arranges events for cricket ...

reviews.review_heading: Networking is your Networth
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of both the college and hostel is very good, not less than a Bollywood movie. It has centralized air conditioners, top-notch canteen. It is located inside the Equinox Business Park. Though it doesn’t provide good facilities, it’s a major issue with most colleges in Mumbai.

reviews.review_heading: Improved infrastructure and industry experience.
reviews.review_text: Our college premises has an excellent, strong Wi-Fi connection on all the floors. The classrooms are spacious and sound proof with many necessities. Our college provides us with different spaces for computer work, libraries and study space. Average quality canteen.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: I like the infrastructure of our college, and one of the reasons for me to choose ISME college was the course and infrastructure. It is in the business hub of the city, and the college provides a lot of corporate exposure as well. The college is very technology-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for entrepreneurial studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is immaculate. The campus is equipped with air conditioners. It is in the heart of the corporate world, which exposes the students to the business world. The college has a fintech lab, a boardroom 2 classrooms, a hall, information media centre and over 15 classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty, great curriculum, good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure. As the institute is set up in a business centre, it gives us professional experience while learning about new age business skills. The college provides us with access to Wi-Fi, library even online library and the classrooms are very appropriate to learn business.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and crowd, Good placements and teacher support.
reviews.review_text: As the college is situated near a business centre, the infrastructure was like a professional office with Wi-Fi, computer lab, library including access to the online library, etc. The classrooms consist of a computer and projectors for professors to teach by showing presentations.

reviews.review_heading: Absolute satisfied with the school and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The school is in the heart of the city, located at elphinstone road. The school is divided into three schools one for design and innovation, one for business, marketing and advertising and third is into management and entrepreneurship. The school is having incubators where the students can come up with their ideas and can turn their ideas into actual businesses, with the support from the faculty and professors from foreign schools and universities.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the course, faculty, and their teaching.
reviews.review_text: It is the best campus in Mumbai. There is no problem when it comes to infrastructure. They have new age libraries, fintech labs, fancy classrooms and good Wi-Fi facilities. There is a lot of space to ideate, create and experiment new things. I have never seen a campus like this earlier.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college to study.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure would beat any college in Mumbai. We have quick and fast Wi-Fi. There are table tennis tables and xerox room. The classrooms are just made for every student to fall in love with them. There is no personal canteen of ISME, but there are 6 other outlets where one can eat on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Indian school of management and entrepreneurship is the new age education.
reviews.review_text: The best infrastructure in any college in India lies at ISME. We have access to free Wi-Fi, Infomedia centre, conference room, fintech exchange, and classrooms. The food is superb and hygienic. The hostel rooms are spacious and well-designed. The campus is eco-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of ISME School of Management and Entrepreneurship.
reviews.review_text: ISME has the best campus in Mumbai, and it is located in One IndiaBulls. It has air-conditioners in each classroom and clean bathrooms. There is a vending machine consisting of snacks. We have Wi-Fi which is accessible in every corner of our campus, and there is a lab with functional laptops.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are amazing and provide experiential learning.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in Indiabulls, which is a corporate building. ISME has a modern and well-equipped infrastructure. It has centralised air-conditioners. Wi-Fi is available on all floors. The college has its own Infotech lab, and a common library is shared with ISME and ISDI college.

review_summary.college_name: Symbiosis Institute of Health Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Public Health (MPH) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure, peaceful place, and nice faculty members.

content.Placements: I'm in my 3rd semester, so it's difficult to say, but I think the placement opportunities depend on us. Our skill set, approach, and where we want to see ourselves, along with guidance from the faculty members. The roles are policy makers, working in NGOs, as researchers, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The quality of the food is average because they have to cook for a lot of people. Classrooms and the library are good, and overall, the infrastructure is excellent. Other than that, facilities in the hostel are very good, we provide a hygienic and clean environment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical Technology (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with every facility of the college.

content.Placements: The total percentage of students placed in this course is 70%. The highest package is 21 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Philips, GE, Siemens, Toshiba, and Fujifilm. Many of the companies are there like I already mentioned 70%. The roles offered are in sales, applications, and technologies.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available on campus. We have Wi-Fi facilities, sitting area, cafeteria, and library. Many of the things are there. The best part of the college is fully greenery on our campus. Like everyday, we get a different kind of food. Our college has a hospital on the campus and too much big grounds are there. Every year they organise sports games from every department.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Paramedical Technology (Honors/Honors with Research) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure, qualified faculty members, amazing placements, no fests and events .

content.Placements: The college has internship partnerships with famous recruiters like Accenture, Wipro, Bajaj, Jupiter Hospital, Manipal Hospital, Jehangir Hospital, Ruby Hall Clinic, etc. Almost every student gets placed by the end of his/her course. The college authorities also place students in the SUHRC, which is the Symbiosis Hospital.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi has been provided to everyone. Classrooms are well-ventilated with a smart board system. The library is provided with a wide range of books accessible to every student. All the sports are available on campus, and tournaments are held every year between institutes. The college has its own hospital where all the services are provided either for free or at a discounted rate for the staff and students of Symbiosis.

paragraphs: Find below the step-wise IIIT Lucknow admission process for all the UG and PG courses for 2025:
1. Qualify for the entrance exam

Students seeking admission to BTech must appear for the JEE Main 2025 exam by applying for the course. MTech and MSc candidates must apply for GATE and IIT Jam, respectively. Similarly, MBA candidates must apply for CUET PG. Check the eligibility criteria on the entrance exam's official website.
2. Counselling

Students have to participate in the counselling process for BTech, MTech, and MSc. Candidates must apply for the BTech via JoSAA counseling, for the MTech via CCMT counselling, and MSc via CCMN counsellingThe bodies.
3. Seat Allocation
JoSAA, CCMT, and CCMN will allocate seats according to the cutoffs for the programme. Candidates must qualify for the cutoff as per the exams.

description: IIIT Lucknow cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIIT Lucknow JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last 8 years of IIIT Lucknow JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

IIIT Lucknow JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the IIIT Lucknow CSE cutoff 2025 was 9947 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive cutoff rank for admission.

For the General AI category students, the IIIT Lucknow B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 9947 and 13233 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 9947 and 10468, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence and B.Tech. in Computer science and Engineering were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at IIIT Lucknow. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at IIIT Lucknow to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of IIIT Lucknow. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisation was M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering with last round cutoff score of 534, for the General AI quota. In the table below, candidates can view the branch-wise first and last round cutoff scores.

Tabulated below are the GATE CCMT last round cutoff scores for 2025, 2024 and 2023 across different rounds, categories and quotas. For the General AI quota, the last round cutoff score was 534. While for the OBC category students, the final round cutoff score was 481 in the AI quota.
Comparing the cutoff range, the competition was higher for the General AI category students as compared to the OBC category students. For other categories' cutoff scores, use the provided filters.

Candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important GATE 2026 dates to be eligible for admission to the ME/MTech course. GATE is the accepting exam, followed by the CCMT counselling process for admission.

Tabulated below are the GATE cutoff lists across different rounds and years for ME/MTech admission at IIIT Lucknow - Indian Institute of Information Technology. The consolidated cutoff list will help students understand the past years cutoff trends.

IIIT Lucknow CCMN cutoff 2025 concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for MSc/MSc Tech courses. M.Sc. in Data Science turned out to be the most competitive option with a lowest last round closing rank of 531 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The easiest option for admission was M.Sc. in Economics and Management, as the admission cutoff was comparatively more relaxed for the students. The last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 1056.

IIIT Lucknow M.Sc. cutoff 2025 was released up to 5 rounds across different categories of students belonging to AI quota. In 2025, the maximum cutoff rank required was 1056 for M.Sc. admission in the General AI category. Please note that cutoff rank for different specialisations, rounds and categories. Considering the last round cutoff, M.Sc. in Data Science emerged as a top choice among the General category, with its cutoff rank settling at 531.

CCMN is the centralised platform for admissions to the MSc and MSc (Tech Programmes) at NITs, IIEST Shibpur, and some CFTI institutes that accept the IIT JAM scorecard. This year, CCMN counselling was conducted for three regular rounds and two special rounds for MSc admission across different participating institutes. Candidates preparing for IIIT Lucknow admission can refer to the table below to view or download the year- and round-wise CCMN cutoff list.

Considering the last round of IIIT Lucknow CCMT cutoff 2025, core M.E./M.Tech branche, including Computer Science and Engineering, witnessed highest cutoff for admission in the General category under the AI quota.

For the OBC category students under the AI quota, the GATE 2025 cutoff score was 481, with M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering being the most challenging for admission. Candidates can use the filters below to view the cutoff scores across different rounds, categories and quotas.

reviews.review_heading: Less college life, a small campus, and above-average placements.
reviews.review_text: Average infrastructure with average Wi-Fi facilities. Average quality of mess and canteen. The course structure is good comparatively because only computer science-related subjects will be taught here, unlike other colleges. A small canteen is available, but all deliveries are available, so no problem with the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Lucknow - Indian Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: The mess food is decent enough and the quality is I won't say good but it is certainly not bad. The medical facility is there for students most of the times. Wi-Fi and sports facilities are also fairly good. The hostels they can't accommodate all the students so the 1st year they stay outside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Lucknow - Indian Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not have a good infrastructure. The Wi-Fi connection is good and working fine. Mess food is good as compared to other colleges. Sports facilities are not that good in our college. We have a gym which has a good number of equipment, and anyone can go to the gym.

reviews.review_heading: Top tier in placements and coding culture.
reviews.review_text: A little bit of satisfaction in terms of hostel and infrastructure. For our batch, the hostel was given outside the college. So we need to travel daily. A bus was provided. Temporary hostel is not so good (no Wi-Fi). Hostel is not so clean. There are many insects and pests, including rats. But this is only for the first semester, so if you deal with it for some time (3-4 months), after you shift to college hostel, you will be okay. College hostel is relatively clean and has good Wi-Fi connection...

reviews.review_heading: Very good placements, very average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly. The infrastructure is bad. The library is not open throughout the complete day. Hostel facilities are very bad. The hostel is outside the campus. The mess is decent. Washrooms are bad. Water facility is bad. Drinking water is at its worst phase.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Lucknow - The institute of national importance.
reviews.review_text: This institution provides every kind of modern facility, including Wi-Fi, computer labs, a fully equipped library, and air-conditioned digital classrooms. Hostels are available, but they are the only negative point. However, you will be provided with all the necessary equipment for your studies. There is also a dedicated mess for students, where the food is decent, although only vegetarian options are available.

reviews.review_heading: The faculties are highly qualified and replacement is also very high
reviews.review_text: The quality of food is very good whereas the canteen in our college is small. If you talk of the sports then there is carrom board, gymnastics, table tennis etc. There is a sports and yoga instructor in our college also. There is a medical room present in our college.

reviews.review_heading: If u are study oriented, you can join this college .
reviews.review_text: Overall the infrastructure is good. All the basic facilities are available in my college. The building is beautiful. Classrooms are big and awesome. Medical facilities are available too. Hostel is decent. We have Wi-Fi and electricity supply, which is also good but the  mess food is not very good .

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Lucknow- Placements are quite impressive.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available here are moderate. The hostel accommodation is quite dissatisfying for boys, as they have to live in rooms that are 10 or 12-seaters, which is a bane for introverts. The food quality given in the mess is decent. The classrooms are equipped with ACs, smart boards, and are a good place to study.

reviews.review_heading: College is worth it for placement and coding culture but not for a good college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is a bit average. Wi-Fi speed is not up to par in every area of college. Labs are well maintained. Classrooms have comfortable chairs and sitting capacity. The quality of hostels is below average, which is not good for boys but better for girls.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for placement with a best coding culture.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is in developing condition. The college has sufficient Wi-Fi speed, approximately 400 Mbps. There are also labs available. As students are living in combined rooms, if they feel any disturbance, they can go to the lab or library. Classrooms are good, with a bench strength of up to 200 students. The food in the mess is not too good but okay. The canteen is open during the day and night until 2 AM. Medical facilities are not available at the moment. For sports, there is a footba...

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the college .
reviews.review_text:
The campus is very nice, as there are two hostels on campus: a three-member room for girls and a dome-type hostel for boys. 
Hostel charges are minimal, around 3k–5k, depending on your choice of room. 
Fully AC classrooms and labs are there that are accessible 24*7. Medical facilities are very nice; a medical room with a medical staff is present in the college. Sports facilities are good, not excellent .

reviews.review_heading: B.Teach in Information technology course from the IIITL.
reviews.review_text: This college provides a good infrastructure for our course. For our course, all the required facilities are provided by the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, parking, sports etc. facilities were available for the students. All these facilities were of good quality and well maintained by the management.

reviews.review_heading: Things to know before taking admission into IIITL.
reviews.review_text: There is no proper hostel for boys, as girls and boy hostels are not separate. Girls occupy the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd floors, while boys are on the ground, 4th, and 5th floors. Boys are also placed in dormitories, with 12 boys in a single room. The medical facility is not up to the mark, but the food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good. Mess is good. But hostels are like a hospital.
reviews.review_text: Hostels for the first year are away from the campus (boys and girls are accommodated on campus), approximately 1.5 km. Mess quality is good. The menu has diverse items. The menu is made in such a way that it covers items from all the regions, from south to north.

Candidates must start by meeting the course-specific eligibility criteria and appear for the relevant entrance exam. The step-wiseBRIM admission processis given below:
Step 1: BRIM Application Process 2025

BRIM application process is conducted online on the official website of the institute. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are required to fill out the application and upload relevant documents. Candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 650 at the time of group discussion and interview.

Step 3: BRIM Final Admission
Selected candidates are required to pay theBRIM feeto secure their seats and visit the college campus for the document verification process.

review_summary.college_name: Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great campus, good placements, supportive faculty members, and worth the investment.

content.Placements: Around 60–70 percent of students get placed every year in reputed companies. The highest package goes up to 15 LPA, the average is around 4 LPA–5 LPA, and the lowest is about 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, Cognizant, IBM, Bosch, and Dell. Many students also get internships in companies like Bosch, Infosys, and startups during their course. The most offered roles are software developer, analyst, and system engineer.
content.Infrastructure: College has a well-maintained campus with greenery. It provides Wi-Fi across the campus. Classrooms are spacious with smart boards and projectors. Labs are fully equipped with modern instruments for practical learning. The library is big, with many reference books, e-books, and journals. Hostel facilities are good. Along with clean rooms, decent security, and 24/7 water and electricity. Mess food is average, but hygienic. There are multiple food options in the canteen. Sports facilities for cricket, football, basketball, and indoor games. Medical facilities with an on-campus hospital are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best engineering college in Bengaluru.

content.Placements: This college has 75% of students placed with good packages from our course. The placement cell is engaged in developing students with all the necessary skills for top companies like Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, L and T, CGI, Robert Bosch, etc. The highest package offered at this college is 16 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA. Over 50% of students get internships from our course. The top roles are engineering knowledge, problem analysis, development of solutions, project management, and finance.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good browsing center. The campus has an HDFC Bank ATM facility. The library and information center are located in an independent, spacious block. The institution has 10 research and development centers. It has a canteen inside the campus, along with good healthcare facilities and its own dental hospital. There are 4 men's hostels and 2 women's hostels that accommodate around 1000 students, with good and healthy food available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has a good environment for study purposes. It has a large playing group on campus.

content.Placements: Our college has 70% of placements. The lowest package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Microsoft, Amazon, HP, Mu Sigma, Caterpillar, Morgan Stanley, Samsung, Pegasystems, Maveric, Fidelity, DE Shaw, Cisco and AIG.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent infrastructure. The whole campus is covered by trees (full of greenery). It has a very large and spacious library with more facilities like a meeting hall for both faculty members and students. Wi-Fi is available in the library. Classrooms are big and have better ventilation, comfortable benches, and distilled water. There is a washroom facility for both girls and boys on each floor. The hostel is the best in terms of food and other facilities like water and drinking water. It is budget-friendly.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college but affiliated with VTU.

content.Placements: More than 50 companies visit the college for campus placements. Around 85-90% of students get placed every year. Top companies like Amazon and Wipro visit the college to hire students. MS recruiters like TCS and Capgemini also hire students. Most of them get jobs related to their course like data analysts.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped. The college infrastructure is also decent. Hostels are also good and well-maintained. There is a large ground and indoor sports. A gym is also available. The campus is spread over 133 acres. There are all types of stadiums for sports like badminton, football and volleyball. Every classroom has a projector.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One can join SIRMVIT without a second thought. You'll not regret it.

content.Placements: The seniors of our passed-out batch claimed that the placements for the 2024-2025 batch are amazing. We saw a good number of companies visiting our campus. Overall, many students got placed in tech and non-tech companies. Placement packages annually are also a decent.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facility is the best when it's about food, it is healthy and good. Wi-Fi is available on campus for every block. Labs are good and the conducting of labs are above average. Classrooms are very spacious and the campus is neat and clean with lush green environment.

reviews.review_text: College has a well-maintained campus with greenery. It provides Wi-Fi across the campus. Classrooms are spacious with smart boards and projectors. Labs are fully equipped with modern instruments for practical learning. The library is big, with many reference books, e-books, and journals. Hostel facilities are good. Along with clean rooms, decent security, and 24/7 water and electricity. Mess food is average, but hygienic. There are multiple food options in the canteen. Sports facilities for cric...

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Bengaluru.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good browsing center. The campus has an HDFC Bank ATM facility. The library and information center are located in an independent, spacious block. The institution has 10 research and development centers. It has a canteen inside the campus, along with good healthcare facilities and its own dental hospital. There are 4 men's hostels and 2 women's hostels that accommodate around 1000 students, with good and healthy food available.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good environment for study purposes. It has a large playing group on campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent infrastructure. The whole campus is covered by trees (full of greenery). It has a very large and spacious library with more facilities like a meeting hall for both faculty members and students. Wi-Fi is available in the library. Classrooms are big and have better ventilation, comfortable benches, and distilled water. There is a washroom facility for both girls and boys on each floor. The hostel is the best in terms of food and other facilities like water and drinking wa...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college but affiliated with VTU.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped. The college infrastructure is also decent. Hostels are also good and well-maintained. There is a large ground and indoor sports. A gym is also available. The campus is spread over 133 acres. There are all types of stadiums for sports like badminton, football and volleyball. Every classroom has a projector.

reviews.review_heading: One can join SIRMVIT without a second thought. You'll not regret it.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is the best when it's about food, it is healthy and good. Wi-Fi is available on campus for every block. Labs are good and the conducting of labs are above average. Classrooms are very spacious and the campus is neat and clean with lush green environment.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college! Satisfied with my department faculty members. Infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: The infra is average. It's quite old. Labs are equipped with Wi-Fi facilities and the library is provided with free books for reference. Hostels are average, the food quality isn't up to the mark. The sports club is active, and the college provides good facilities for indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It's not a good college, but it's okay to join for a proper greenery view.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at the college are okay because we don’t have any Wi-Fi. The labs are okay but have limited computers working. Classrooms are okay. The broken library is under construction, and it will be better because it will be a digital library, and to be frank, better than the college. The library is good now, and it will be opened in 2026, I guess. The canteen food is the worst. The non-veg food is made in only one Kadai. Medical facilities are also not available because there is no departm...

reviews.review_heading: The good thing about the college is its faculty members and the bad thing is its environment.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very awesome. It is spread over 113 acres of land. Mainly our college is surrounded by plants and trees which give us very pure air. The college is out of Bengaluru city, so there is a traffic problem. I am a day scholar, so I do not stay at the college hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SIR M. Visvesvaraya Institute review.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities at Sir MVIT are comfortable and well-equipped. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, with rooms available in single, double, and triple-sharing formats. Each room has basic furniture like beds, study tables, chairs, and cupboards.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with average faculty and big college vibes.
reviews.review_text:
Hostel are good.
In short, you'll learn your life there only. 
In hostels, the wardens are not bad.
You'll see the great Indian separation in hostel.
Like north and south India are almost separate.
And otherwise, people are like brothers in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: The college crowd and campus life are really great and the facilities provided are also very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is just above average, as the buildings built here are very old but the facilities that are being offered here are more than sufficient for an idol student. Talking about the hostel, everything here is very good, as we get food on time and the water is also very clean.

reviews.review_heading: Actual, our college is good for placement.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are not that good. There is no proper infrastructure for the hostels, and they don't provide good food. The washrooms and rooms are not clean, and I’ve seen some of the worst washrooms ever. It is one of the worst hostel experiences in Bangalore, and there is also no proper water supply.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities
reviews.review_text: A very big and high tech library, labs, big classrooms, coffee shops, sitting area etc are there. Hostel is overall good and spacious. Food is better than other hostels and hostel fees is decent. Clean hostels and a small shop inside the hostel as well as a hostel library is there.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission in this college. It is totally a waste of time and money.
reviews.review_text: The worst infrastructure, not good classrooms; they don't have good facilities in labs; restrictions on sitting anywhere; faculty are not very friendly and helpful in nature; they don't have wi-fi facilities on campus; there is only one canteen and it is very small.

reviews.review_heading: Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology, Bangalore (College Review).
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good; we have our own personal Wi-Fi, which we bought for our own expenses (4-6 students) together, though there is some news that now the Wi-Fi will be provided by the administration. Mess food is above average if compared to nearby colleges. So some days it is literally very good, but there are also a also a few days when the food is not that good (though it is edible) (most of the caterers are from UP, Bihar and Jharkhand).

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: AMC Engineering College, Bengaluru.

content.Placements: In AMC Engineering College, I chose CSE AI/ML in which 70% of students got placed. The highest package offered is more than 25 LPA. The average package offered is 6 LPA-7 LPA, and the median package offered is 5 LPA. Companies like Infosys, Wipro, TCS, and Capgemini visit our college. individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with campus placement.

individual_reviews.title: If you want to have fun and have no aim in life please join to AMC ENGINEERING COLLEGE.

admission_overview.college_name: AMC Engineering College Admission 2025: Eligibility, Application Process, Fee, Dates

paragraphs: AMC Engineering College admissionisopen.It offers Engineering, Science, and Management courses at the UG, PG and PhD levels. Admission to all the courses is done basis national or state level entrance exam. It provides courses in affiliation withVTUBelagavi. the programmes are offered in full-time and regular modes.

AMC Engineering College course admissionis entrance-based. Students should meet the admission criteria as per the guidelines issued by the college. The eligibility for UG courses is a pass in Class 12 while for PG courses, students should have completed their graduation degree. AMCEC shortlists students based on several parameters, including entrance exam, group discussion, and personal interview. The selection process is followed by institute-level counselling for seat allotment. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection criteria forAMC Engineering College courses:
Class 12 with 45% aggregate in PCM for GM students and above 40% aggregate for SC/ ST students
UG degree with a minimum aggregate of 50% from a recognised university
UG degree in any stream with a minimum aggregate of 50% from a recognised university
UG degree with a 50% aggregate from a recognised university

AMC Engineering College admission is a multi-step process starting with the application, followed by selection round, and then counselling and admission confirmation. Students should meet the eligibility criteria before applying for the course. They should have a valid score in the national or state-level entrance exam. Refer to the pointers below to know the admission process:
1. AMCEC Application Process
Visit the official website and select the programme. Fill the online application form with all the listed details. Then submit the form.
2. AMCEC Selection Process

The application forms will be scrutinised, and the selection will be made based on the eligibility criteria. Selected candidates will be invited for a counselling interview. Candidates can choose any options for the interview process, which are one-on-one, online, or telephonic. Additionally, candidates must also appear for the entrance exam, personal interview, and group discussion as per the programme requirements.
3. Merit-list and Counselling

Wait for the merit list to be announced by the college. The merit list will be based on the entrance exam scores and other criteria such as cutoffs, academic performance, work experience, etc. Attend the counselling process and follow the guidelines provided by the college. The counselling process will involve document verification, seat allotment, fee payment, etc.
4. Seat offer

Once the application process and interviews are completed, the college admissions official sends an admission offer to the candidates. The candidate must accept the offer by confirming it and paying the course fees.

paragraphs: During the ICCMRT placements 2024, the highest package offered to the MBA graduates was INR 8.5 LPA . The average package offered to the MBA program was INR 5 LPA . The season 2024 achieved 96% placements where 68 MBA students got placed. More than 30 recruiters took part in the hiring drive and made 23 offers in total. The leading companies that took part during the ICCMRT placements 2024 were Axis Bank, Accenture, 99 Acres and many others.

The institute concluded the 2023 placement session with 100% of students placed . The highest package and average package offered to the MBA batch 2021-23 was INR 8.50 LPA and NR 4 LPA , respectively. A total of 132 MBA students were placed. More than 30 companies participated in 2023 placements. Further, 54 multiple job offers were grabbed by the MBA batch. ITC Limited, Naukri.com, and IDFC First Bank among others were some of the leading companies that were part of the Institute of Co-operative and Corporate Management, Research and Training placements 2023.

hostel_campus.college_name: ICCMRT Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Great College in Lucknow with best faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college campus provides Wi-Fi and has a well-stocked library. Hostel facilities are available on campus, although I did not need them as I am from local Lucknow. The campus does not have a canteen, but it has sports facilities including grounds for badminton and basketball, as well as a table tennis area.

reviews.review_heading: ICCMRT is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is very good, and there is a good environment to study. Good food is served here, and many sports and games activities are conducted on the campus. The canteen establishment process is going and is at the administration level. There is a good medical facility, and our college appointed a doctor from the government sector.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good to take admission yet needed to improve .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Although the campus is not air conditioned but the classrooms are air conditioned. The library and labs facility is good. The hostel facility is good. But the food quality is average. There is no canteen in the campus also no facility for the sports.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is one of the best B-schools in AKTU.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like air-conditioned classrooms, computer labs and a huge library. The college also provides separate hostel facility for both boys and girls. Quality of food served in the mess is also good. The college also provides a badminton court. The college organises all the cultural programs on its auditorium.

reviews.review_heading: This college is average .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is okay and Hostel infrastructure is also quite okay. But facilities for the hostelers is not so good. The food of the hostel is very bad. Student's main concern is always food because according to the fees they don't give that much time on food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with helpful faculty members, but the hostel facility should be improved.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our college are average. The college provides well air-conditioned classrooms and a computer lab. Wi-Fi facility is not available on our campus, and the library was not air-conditioned. Our auditorium was the best in all colleges affiliated by AKTU. The hostel facility was below average, and the food served was not good. There is only one badminton court. There are no fields to play cricket or any other sports. It provides a medical room in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It is an awesome college, which provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are awesome and always support students. There are good classrooms, library, sports and medical facilities available on the campus. There is no canteen available in the college. Overall, the infrastructure of the college is good, and I never face any infrastructure-related issue.

reviews.review_heading: Avoid this institute. It is not better than any average private institute.
reviews.review_text: The quality of our infrastructure is very bad. There is no WiFi facility. Labs are very small. No proper medical facilities are available on the premises. Quality of labs and classrooms is poor. Food in the canteen is edible. Hostel rooms are a complete mess.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with our college. It is also known as IIM of AKTU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not much good. The campus area is small compared to the other colleges. There is a Wi-Fi facility, computer lab, library, etc., in our college. Our college has one auditorium and one seminar hall. Our college also has one badminton court. There is a separate girls' and boys' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for placements, but not for experiencing college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. There are no facilities for any indoor or outdoor games except a badminton court. The classrooms in the college are average. There are also library facilities, but the condition is that you can only borrow 4 books at a time. The college mess is not good at all.

reviews.review_heading: I am storngly satisfied because the faculty is very supportive.
reviews.review_text: My college is Semi Government College so there no such a good facility and a good infrastructure as compared to private college. There is Wi-Fi labs classroom library medical facilities and sports and games are available in my college. The quality of labs and classroom are good. The hostel room was also very good in my college I surely say that I didn't face any infrastructure related issues during my tenure.

reviews.review_heading: Soul of the college is, simple living and high thinking.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just like an average college as it is a semi-government college, in addition to that, there are few government offices too in the premises like CBI court. There is a small lawn or garden, where we used to sit around. There is a badminton court too. A well-maintained hostel is also there. A well-equipped computer lab and a magnificent auditorium, are present which I liked the most.

reviews.review_heading: My college was best for me.
reviews.review_text: There are huge Wi-Fi labs, AC classroom, A huge library, all modern medical facilities, a playground like a football, cricket, volleyball, badminton court, etc. There are well-furnished classrooms, libraries and labs as well. There is a canteen with the best quality of fast food and junk food both. There are also separate hostels for the boys and girls, and all rooms are well furnished. I have also not faced any types of issues regarding its infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching, strict discipline, and poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Being a semi-government college, the infrastructure is not up to the mark, however, the teaching is excellent. The campus is very small and Wi-Fi is not available. The library is good but they don't give more than 4 books at a time. There is no canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Great college of AKTU for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The college has its own hostel for the students and provides all the facilities like washing machine, room cooler, etc. It also has a ground for badminton and volleyball. An annual function is conducted by the college every year where all the students participates.

reviews.review_heading: It's eco-friendly environment education.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities and infrastructure are very nice. The BBA course is very useful for me. The Wi-Fi network, labs, classroom, and library are available. Our college has a very eco-friendly environment. The hostel facilities are better. The quality of food is better. The canteen facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Students are friendly, no ragging. Good sports ground, clean hostel, and good food.
reviews.review_text: Lab, classrooms, and hostel are very neat and good. Hostel is surrounded by trees and it gives nature and good oxygen on campus. There are 5 canteens available, food is also good. There are so many students participating sports and win the prices.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and industry exposure with scope for improvement in placements.
reviews.review_text: PMIST offers Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, a vast library, and an industry-focused learning space for MBA students. The hostel provides comfortable accommodation, hygienic food, medical support, and sports facilities, ensuring a well-rounded student experience.

reviews.review_heading: Good in terms of infrastructure and teaching.

reviews.review_heading: Undoubtedly satisfied because of faculty members, placements in 2024, infrastructure, etc.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members clearly explained the course and practicals. Labs are also full of good facilities. The infrastructure of our university gives a pleasant feel. The canteen and medical facilities are also good for us. We want more games.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers a high-quality education and boasts excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is modern and well-maintained, offering a conducive learning environment. Classroom facilities are equipped with up-to-date technology, and study spaces are ample and comfortable. Hostel accommodations are clean and secure, providing a comfortable living experience. Dining facilities offer a variety of healthy and affordable meal options. Overall, the infrastructure and hostel facilities contribute positively to student life and academic pursuits.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is very good and provides all the required infrastructure for students.
reviews.review_text: They provide high lab facilities and proper guidance. Every classroom has a projector. The food is tasty and hygienic at an affordable price. Our university conducts a sports day to encourage sports activities and have good medical facilities. It is available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Really good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. We have a zero-carbon campus, a big library, and free Wi-Fi for projects. The canteen food is vet good. All types of sports are here. We have a robotics lab and AC classrooms. We are provided with the best medical facilities on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: I got extra time while doing my graduation as I was not stressed about my course and had more time.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are environment-friendly. Labs are separately available for B.Sc. and M.Sc. students. The hostel food is very hygienic and safe for students. The indoor stadium is highly designed for good audio signal. The environment is eco-friendly and a zero-carbon zone.

reviews.review_heading: Good, I suggest to join our college.
reviews.review_text: There is an eco-friendly and zero-carbon campus. We refer to Proquest and online journals. There is a library named Arjun Singh Library. Classrooms have neat desks and boards. hostel_campus.college_name: SKIT Jaipur Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Placements here are good as compared to others.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel consists of 460 rooms, where each room has a single bed. There are eight rooms on one floor. The hostel is six floors high, and each floor contains ten washrooms and five bathrooms. We have four wardens who take care of the boys in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SKIT honest review based on recent update.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available such as a canteen, sports, and a nearby medical shop but the infrastructure is average and you wont get the 5 star facility. The chair in CS block is comfortable and restful. The hostel is okay, option for a nearby PG or flat if available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is study focused.
reviews.review_text: The environment or infrastructure is well-maintained in our college. Our CSE department is well-maintained in the college. Computers are of the latest Windows, and we have Wi-Fi in every computer lab. Hostels have both facilities, AC and non-AC. The rent for hostel is reasonable.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, our college is well-maintained.
reviews.review_text: The environment and infrastructure are well-maintained at our college. Our CSE department is well-maintained. Computers are the latest Windows version and have Wi-Fi in every computer lab. The hostel has both AC and non-AC. The rent of the hostel is reasonable.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for those students who want to focus on their engineering life
reviews.review_text: In my college, SKIT, there are well-maintained facilities and infrastructure. Classrooms are neat and clean, well arranged. The library is well maintained with a variety of books and separate rooms to study. For your laptop work, there is a separate room to study, and for your college work, there is a room where computers are provided with internet.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with placements, infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a great infrastructure available for my course, especially with many labs for coding. In the library, we have a different section no. 4, and is only for CS students. College has decent mess and quality food, and the canteen food is great, and we upgrade sports facilities, and their extracurricular activities happen after some days to days.

reviews.review_heading: My journey as a SKIT fresher.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is not provided, and there are a lot of internet problems. Labs and the library are good, and classrooms are a little outdated. The hostel provides facilities like sports and different clubs like S&T, Toastmasters, and there is an incubation centre, which is a great initiative. Every Wednesday is assigned for activities.

reviews.review_heading: College is mediocre but good for low percentile students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are average, you get limited Wi-Fi that is approximately 3 GB only, and sometimes the Wi-Fi signal is not available, usually in the basement area. The food quality is average, and the hygiene is medium. There is a food timetable which is followed, and you get 4 meals per day.

reviews.review_heading: Average but good for the low percentile.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average, they provide limited Wi-Fi in the hostel and campus, around 3 GB/day. The library is good, but it is always crowded. Mess food is okayish, which means it is better than PGS nearby, but it's too boring to eat the same food sometimes they make the same dishes better, and sometimes they don't.

reviews.review_heading: Very strict college.
reviews.review_text: I'm a day scholar, but from my friends I got to know that the hostel is good and clean. The washrooms are hygienic, and the food is good too. You won't get very good food, but it's bearable. Wi-Fi facility is available with a good range. Overall, the ambience and rooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty are highly educated and good in behaviour.
reviews.review_text: The labs are very well managed by their respective teacher. The classrooms are highly maintained and are well-furnished. There are projectors in many classrooms. The quality of food in the mess is good, and the library is also maintained. The classroom quality is good and well-furnished.

reviews.review_heading: College life is once in a lifetime experience.
reviews.review_text: Everything is present AC rooms, non-AC rooms, the food is good, and Wi-Fi is also available, but there is a limit of 3 GB per day. Classrooms are great, faculty members are awesome in behavior, and great sports. So that’s all that is required for you to know.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is small. College life is boring. More oriented in study.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, but with a limit. Labs are good. The best thing is the SKIT library, where you will get all the study material for your exams, and the environment is also good for studying. In classrooms, there are no AC in B.Teach courses. Sports facilities are also average. You can play some games here, like cricket, basketball, badminton, and football, but the grounds are not that great. There is a gym in college, but you will be charged for that.

reviews.review_heading: Focused on studies but a hectic schedule.
reviews.review_text: Only modern infrastructure is library, classrooms are decent but look old, new building is under construction. There are 3 grounds (volleyball, football, and kabbadi), 3 gardens (small in size), a tennis court, a badminton court, and an in-house gym. This college is bigger than PIET and JECRC foundation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology Management and Gramothan, Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in this course. The infrastructure of this college is so nice. Only Wi-Fi is not available, but all other things are present in this course. The canteen food is so nice. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Iot and Cyber Security With Block Chain Technology) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college for those who want a bright future with good placements.

content.Placements: Currently, almost 70% of students are placed from our department. The highest package may go up to 20+ LPA, and the lowest is 3+ LPA. Companies like Siemens, TCS, etc., come for recruitment. More than 80% of students get internships in companies like Infosys, TCS, and Accolades. Main job roles include Cyber Security Engineer, IoT Systems Engineer, Security Analyst / SOC Engineer, Application Security Engineer, and Penetration Tester. Students can also enter jobs like Software Engineer, Developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms, library, and labs are good, but the problem is that you do not get proper Wi-Fi in hostels. Proper Wi-Fi is only available in the main block of the campus. Hostel food is good. We have AC cuisine and a medical room where a doctor is available 4–5 days a week. In sports, if you have talent, they take you to higher levels.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2027

Every faculty guides us for our placements, and there are special skills being trained here.
content.Infrastructure: It is quite good hostel and all the facilities I really enjoy being in the hostel of our college. Food and every facility are great in our college. reviews.review_heading: An honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are fully air-conditioned. The college library is filled with various kinds of books that help students gain more knowledge about their respective subjects. The hostel is very good. It has washing machines, good food, 2 beds per room and a large space.

reviews.review_heading: MITE - Where stones are turned into diamonds.
reviews.review_text: We have good Wi-Fi facilities, well-maintained labs, and library. The food provided in our hostel mess is delicious. The quality is also good. Our classrooms have good AC facilities where we can sit comfortably and are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Join MITE: Where stone turns into diamond.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-suited and well-ventilated. They are air-conditioned. The library is spacious and has all text books which are required for our studies. It also has computers and a digital library.

reviews.review_heading: MITE offers great infrastructure and placements, but faculty members quality needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available all over campus at a speed of 100 Mbps, but there is no connection in hostel. About hostel facilities, we get a morning breakfast from 7:30 AM to 8:30 AM followed by an afternoon meal from 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM, and then we get some snacks in the evening and dinner at 7:00 PM. In a medical facility, we only have one room with a bed and a doctor who's likely to be there.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in Bangalore. It has an anti-ragging campus.
reviews.review_text: It has one of the best air-conditioner and non-air-conditioner equipped classrooms and the best hostel rooms. Everything is clean and tidy. Wi-Fi is decent. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian canteens are available separately with an air-conditioner facility. There are 6 separate grounds for dedicated sports. Medical facilities are good. It also has a bus facility for day scholars.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good course. If you are passionate, you can take this course. Or else, it is a waste of time.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Labs are also good compared to other colleges. The teaching is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, I’m very much satisfied. I’m happy to recommend.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good. Compared to other colleges in our locality, MITE College has good infrastructure. The college has a very big campus. The classrooms, labs, and canteens are very good. The hostel and the food are very tasty. The library contains many books.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities. But this year number of recruitments and placements is less.
reviews.review_text: Good food is provided in hostel canteen or mess, and weekly 3 days medical facilities are available. There is good-conditioned equipment in laboratory. Good library services are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, this is the best college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. Classrooms are best with air-conditioners and projectors. Free Wi-Fi is available across the college. Labs are good and have advanced computers. Hostel rooms are very good. We also have mess, canteen, medical, sports and games. Overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and future of students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good. The Wi-Fi is available at the college. The classrooms are good. The labs have good equipment. The library has all the books. We have huge play ground. The hostel is available at the college. The hostel has a 24-hour hot water facility with home-made food.

individual_reviews.title: Our college provides good placements.

content.Placements: Good companies visit the college for placements. All are friendly here. Top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Smart Data, WCL, CEAT, R. Sandeesh Group, etc. The highest package offered is 19 LPA. 90% of students do internships in companies like NTPC, KTPS, Cognizant, and BSNL, so it is the best for students.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Power Electronics and Power Systems - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Innovation, education, and transformation.

content.Placements: WCEM has an active training and placement cell that organizes soft skill workshops [ mock interviews, aptitude tests, and career counseling]. It also coordinated internships, placements, and campus recruitment drives. In 2024-25, over 80 companies participated in campus hiring drives.
content.Infrastructure: Approximately 12 acres with lush greenery and well-maintained open space. The main building resembles a white house aesthetic. Around 31 classrooms and seminar halls, ICT-enabled teaching aids, and design interactive learning. Stream -specific lab equipped with tools for digital electronics, microprocessor, VLSI, signal processing, CAD.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is quite good if students are looking for moderate colleges for a quick degree.

content.Placements: There are not that many placement opportunities for Diploma students. Companies that came are quite few. I don't think anyone actually did get a job, besides 2-3 students. Roles offered are just junior engineer or assistant engineer, and very few really got it.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi access is quite good, and the food is moderate as well. Access to sports is good. I don't know about the hostel as I used to travel from my home. Classrooms are quite clean, and the vented labs are not that well-equipped. Some computers are working, and some are not.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in CAD/CAM - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent platform for quality education.

content.Placements: From the 3rd semester, M.Teach students become eligible for campus placement. Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Bajaj Allianz, JSW, L&T, and TATA are some companies that have visited my college. The highest package offered is 17.3 LPA by Bajaj Allianz, and the average package is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. All facilities required for the M.Teach Department are available, such as well-equipped laboratories, classrooms, a comprehensive library, reliable Wi-Fi connectivity, etc. Other facilities are also available, like boys' and girls' hostels, a canteen, and a Sports Department.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, well-structured course.

content.Placements: Around 70 to 80% of the students from the AIDS batch were successfully placed during campus. The highest package is 7.2 LPA, and the average package is 2.4 LPA. Top companies like TCS, Capgemini, Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, LTI Hexaware, and Persistent are startup-like web stars in the IT network.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are available separately for boys and girls with good security and a decent study environment. Rooms are mostly shared by two or three students, cleaned regularly, and have amenities such as water purifiers and wardrobes. Overall, the infrastructure is good and continually improving to support both academics and student well-being.

reviews.review_text: The college had well-maintained labs and library. The washrooms were well cleaned, and daily cleaning of the washrooms was performed. The classrooms where students sat were better planned. There was hostel facility for boys, although the rooms were well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Good choice for engineering.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with a well-equipped lab of materials, and a special computer lab available in all departments. Good quality of food provided by canteen. First aid medical facilities, cricket ground, basketball, and volleyball ground are provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent place of education.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-equipped computer labs, Wi-Fi connections, and CNC machines and other instruments which are required for practical. Our college has a well-maintained hostel, separate hostel is there for boys and girls, and it has spacious and comfortable rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Wainganga College of Engineering and Management review.
reviews.review_text: College has decent infrastructure for engineering courses, including well-equipped labs for Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical, and Civil branches, smart classrooms with projectors, a central library with good reference material, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. There are dedicated computer labs with updated software and internet access for project work. The hostel facilities are average to good, with separate accommodation for boys and girls, basic furnished rooms, 24-hour security, a mess serving...

reviews.review_heading: It's satisfactory because of the faculty. The college campus and infrastructure are very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is very good. In college, separate departments for different fields are available. Hostel is very good, and the facilities available from food to medical. They have a canteen, which is very good for the students. Apart from this, sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is excellent, and faculty members are highly qualified.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent, with well-equipped labs that give practical knowledge. The canteen facility is available with the best quality meals in an air-conditioned. The college building infrastructure is attractive. There is a ground and greenery environment on the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good overall.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of the college were really good. Classrooms were well-organized, and good library with enough course-related content available. The food quality in the mess and the canteen was also really good.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Wainganga College of Engineering and Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very impressive and big. It just looks like a Taj hotel. There are various facilities like a Wi-Fi connection, a library, and more than 50 classrooms according to their department. Various facilities are available in the hostel.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Mahindra University, Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Mahindra University Hyderabad offers entrance-based admission to BTech. Further, for BBA, BBA LLB, BJMC, and others, the university offers merit-based admission. Applicants seeking admission to BTech, are required to appear in one entrance exam accepted by the university i.e. JEE Main and SLAT. Further, for admission to all other UG and PG courses, admission is based on the last qualifying exam score i.e. Pass Class 12 for UG courses, pass graduation for PG courses and pass master's degree for admission to PhD courses.

faqs.question: Can I apply for admission to various courses at Mahindra University?
faqs.answer: Mahindra University admissions are open for all courses. The university offers merit-based admission to all UG, PG, and Doctoral courses. Further, for admission to BTech, candidates are required to appear in one entrance exam i.e. JEE Main and SAT accepted by the college. Candidates seeking admission to Mahindra University must fill out the online application form by visiting the university's official website.

faqs.question: Can I join Mahindra University Hyderabad directly?
faqs.answer: Mahindra University Hyderabad direct admissions are only possible for some courses. For other courses, students will have to appear for the entrance exams. The mode ofMahindra University course admissionsis online. Admission to various courses is based on merit and entrance exam scores. The accepted entrance exams areJEE Main, SAT India, and others. Candidates willing to get admission must visit the official website and click on the Apply Now tab. Select the required course and pay the application fee. Fill out and submit the application form with the required information.

reviews.review_text: Campus is so huge and surrounded by trees. Classrooms are good, and a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility is available. Hostel rooms are so good. Washrooms are clean. reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my Nano technology course is good with well equipped classrooms and labs. The hostel facilities are also good with comfortable cottages and a well stocked library. The mess serves good quality food and there's a clinic on campus with a certified doctor. The total cost of my course is 4.5 Lacs per annum, and the hostel fee is 2 Lacs per annum.

reviews.review_heading: A well all-rounded university great for personal and professional growth.
reviews.review_text: Everything is great. There is a great variety of food catering to all, including vegetarian and Jains. Facilities are modern and up to date. reviews.review_heading: Decent placements are available after course completion.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of our college are pretty good. The facilities available in our college include smart classrooms, sports facilities mainly related to indoor sports, and a medical room. The hostels have decent facilities, and the mess offers good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: It's a practical-based course curriculum with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is not very large but offers many facilities. There are sports grounds where we can play cricket, football, volleyball, tennis, etc. A medical room is available for treatment. CCTV cameras are installed in classrooms and labs. Cafeterias serve good-quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure. Two students share a single room. Air-conditioners and two fans are available in the rooms. Wi-Fi is available. The quality of the food in the mess is excellent. They serve a variety of food. The library is good and huge. Many books are available. Labs are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied because of the difficulty of exams but our campus has good environment.

reviews.review_heading: The amount of supplementary exam is too high, i.e. 5k.
reviews.review_text:
The classrooms are very neat and they can accommodate upto 100 students and in some classrooms upto 200.
The Physics and electrical labs have all equipments working and they are in good numbers. The hostel rooms are spacious and clean. The mess food is hygienic and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are excellent. Wi-Fi facilities are very good with a very good connection. The food served in the mess and canteen is very hygienic. A variety of food is served. The hospital is open 24X7. There are many sports, including basketball, cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, chess, pool, and table tennis. There are also two gyms open to all.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mahindra University.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. The classrooms are very spacious and are air-conditioned. The college has big lecture halls. The college hostels are well maintained and have a good environment. There are labs for the students as well. There is also a library which has all the necessary books required by students.

reviews.review_heading: This college provides excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the mess is excellent. Our college has all facilities that students would require like, basketball courts, football field, table tennis, gym, volleyball courts, snooker room, etc. It also provides the infrastructure for research and engineering for working on drones, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Mahindra university has the best hostels. It's worth the money. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is very good. The mess is thoroughly maintained. We also have a gym, basketball courts, volleyball court, cricket ground, badminton courts, tennis courts, and a big football ground. We also have a small clinic.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is average and our college is a good platform to perceive higher studies.
reviews.review_text: All courses in our college are provided with materials needed in the library, labs, Wi-Fi on campus, and dorms. We have a clinic for medical situations and ambulance in case of emergencies. The hostel room is shared by only 2 people with attached bathroom for girls and common washroom for boys. The food and security is very good. We have various indoor and outdoor sports such as football, tennis, cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good if students could not make it to IITs.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good in this college. Mess is good and it is a way far better than any other hostels. It provides a library lawn and classes are very well maintained. Wi-Fi is not that well maintained but can be sufficient for a normal user. A lot of variety of e-books and offline books are also provided in the library.

reviews.review_heading: The college has really good infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Mahindra University is very good compared to all the EAMCET colleges. The hostels are also kept clean and tidy. The food is average. Sports facilities and medical facilities are excellent. The classrooms and labs are well maintained.
