individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Suryadatta Institute of Management and Mass Communication.

content.Placements: We are all looking forward to some good companies with good salary packages but it doesn't happen at any of the times. The basic range of salary would be between 2.4 LPA to 3.2 LPA. Mostly look for the MBA graduates for the roads like BPO banking and other insurance companies.
content.Infrastructure: Just in case, students' suggestions for deciding the regular main menu of the canteen are asked but finally they cook according to their monthly budget. The most important thing in the hostel is to be on time for the dining areas, otherwise you won't get any food because they are usually planned in limited quantities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Suryadatta College Campus Review.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed for the course is such that the students can be counted on fingers, maybe 7 to 8 out of a batch of 200. The starting package is 2 LPA or just a trainee. No MNC companies recruit. Internships were found and done by the students themselves for the project, with no college support given.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course is very small, as the campus is not that big, and many departments are in a single building with no proper playground, which is made of cement. There is no hostel facility from the college, and the students live in third-party hostels near the college.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued Jan(2026) PGDM + MDP + CDP - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good College for locals of Pune but a little bit tough for other state students.

content.Placements: Batch size is 100. Average placement is between 4 to 5 LPA. ROI is low. The fee of PGDM is 6,90000 Rs. But from next year the college is going to discontinue PGDM courses from their PG programme. PGDM is a good course we got to learn new things and made several visits.
content.Infrastructure: The college does not provide a hostel. You can live near the college or can get a private hostel near the college.
content.Faculty: The faculty is good. The nature of the teachers is good. They are very helpful. But the con is the language barrier.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued Jan(2026) PGDM + MDP + CDP - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Glad to be pursuing course in Suryaddatta institute.

content.Placements: From 6th semester we are allowed to take part in placement process. The eligibility varies based on the company; some companies have a cutoff of 7 CGPA, some have 8 or 8.5; it varies. Some of the company names that visited our college are IBM, Blackrock, Infosys, MSCI, Seagate, Siemens, Wolters, etc. Each company gave offers to 5-20 students. Average package is around 6 lakh/year.
content.Infrastructure: I am not able to state the gender ratio in the course. The institute organized various workshop activities for students. They also arranged cultural events for us. Suryaddata is excellent in all those points mentioned, which are mentioned above. Suryadatta organized study tours for us.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued Jan(2026) MBA + CDP - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Strict and disciplined college.

content.Placements: In our 2019 batch, Suryadatta has the highest number of placements, with about 90% of students placed on campus. Wipro is the highest recruiter; it hires 15 students in the role of account officer, followed by TCS and HCL. The highest salary is 15 LPA, the average is 4 LPA, and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. It depends on the interview. The roles offered are analyst, account officer, and management trainee.
content.Infrastructure: Suryadatta campus is sweet and simple, but it is far away from the main Pune and Pimpri Chinchwad, nearly 30 km away. The college has a library and a normal library. In a normal library, thousands of books are available. Classrooms have boards, AC, fans, projectors, and benches. The hostel feels it is near about 1 lacs 30 thousand, in which food is included and facilities are good. Food have veg and non-veg options. On-campus, CCTV cameras are everywhere.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Suryadatta Institute of Management and Mass Communication.
reviews.review_text: Just in case, students' suggestions for deciding the regular main menu of the canteen are asked but finally they cook according to their monthly budget. The most important thing in the hostel is to be on time for the dining areas, otherwise you won't get any food because they are usually planned in limited quantities.

reviews.review_heading: Suryadatta College Campus Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is very small, as the campus is not that big, and many departments are in a single building with no proper playground, which is made of cement. There is no hostel facility from the college, and the students live in third-party hostels near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Good College for locals of Pune but a little bit tough for other state students.
reviews.review_text: The college does not provide a hostel. You can live near the college or can get a private hostel near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Glad to be pursuing course in Suryaddatta institute.
reviews.review_text: I am not able to state the gender ratio in the course. The institute organized various workshop activities for students. They also arranged cultural events for us. Suryaddata is excellent in all those points mentioned, which are mentioned above. Suryadatta organized study tours for us.

reviews.review_heading: Strict and disciplined college.
reviews.review_text: Suryadatta campus is sweet and simple, but it is far away from the main Pune and Pimpri Chinchwad, nearly 30 km away. The college has a library and a normal library. In a normal library, thousands of books are available. Classrooms have boards, AC, fans, projectors, and benches. The hostel feels it is near about 1 lacs 30 thousand, in which food is included and facilities are good. Food have veg and non-veg options. On-campus, CCTV cameras are everywhere.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: There is nothing special about the infrastructure. We have a moderate sized campus and sports are very rare in the college which are not encouraged. The students do not have any mood to play sports. College provides facilities including a library, e library, Wi-Fi, etc. There is a separate hostel for both boys and girls with 2 students sharing one room having 24*7 security, food and all other essential facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good days in Suryadatta IMMC.
reviews.review_text: Surystsav is an event that is conducted by the college. Every year, many sports competitions, expos, and days are celebrated. Classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi, a whiteboard, a microphone, and a stage. Yes, I am a hosteller; it is the opposite of what the college fee is: 125000 per year. Each room has two beds and 2 tables. Geysers are available and there is 24*7 full-water availability .

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and friendly faculty.
reviews.review_text: They provide good facilities Wi-Fi is available all day, the computer lab has internet connectivity, and the library has a big collection of books. The hostel fee is 1,25,000 per year for each room. There are two members, two beds., two study tables, two chair and a separate locker. Water is available 24 hours a day. We have sports grounds but do not have indoor sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Very strict campus. We have to always be on time. Compulsory dress code.
reviews.review_text:
Yes, I have opted for a campus hostel. The hostel is expensive. But it is the opposite of our college. Fully secured. Hostel fees: INR 1,25,000/year Each room has two students. Two beds, two study tables, two chairs, and a separate locker system are available. Greaser is available. 24-hour water facility is there. There are so many PGs available in the surrounding area of our campus.
Hostel Fee: INR 125,000 per year
External Expenses: Rs. 2000–Rs. 4000

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. The library has study materials. Our college crowd is more. Labs are good. They have computers. Wi-Fi is available in a few places. The canteen should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good for our career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. We have a good environment in libraries, laboratories, etc. Our classrooms have clean desks, projectors, ceiling fans, lights, etc. The food served in the canteen is hygienic. Our college has a huge auditorium hall, where seminars and other activities are performed.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college for PGDM in Pune.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like good classrooms, internet labs, a library, and teaching staff members. They have the best environment to study in. Facilities like separate rooms for studies, a study table, a bed, hot water for a bath, lights, etc. are available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The T&P department is very supportive and very active in all the placement activities.
reviews.review_text: I was there for 1 year in the hostel, the hostel facilities are quite okay and recommendable. The canteen is also satisfactory and the facilities like water, electricity and all are also very good, the security is also good and the staff is also supportive.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and teaching, and learning innovations are good.
reviews.review_text: The institute has a spacious library. It provides a wide information source, which includes 24,322 regular textbooks. The library has the latest information technology like multimedia kits, barcode, media scanner and text and graphics scanner. Quality of facilities is available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because it provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like good classrooms, internet labs, a good environment for study, library and teaching staff members. Facilities like a separate room for study, study table, bed, hot water for a bath, lights, etc., are available in the hostel. Quality of food served in the mess is good. Medical facilities are also available in the hostel.

review_content.General: Our campus is small. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners, smart boards, speakers, and mics. Classrooms are one of the best in Bhubaneswar. Labs are average. The Wi-Fi facility is not good. Hostels are not good. They won't provide any facilities even after complaining. Previously, the Wi-Fi was good. The library is basic. It has a lot of spiritual books along with course books, regular newspapers, and magazines. Hostels are situated very far. The hostel provides personal bathrooms and regular cleaning services. The hostel rooms are large and well-ventilated. The hostel rooms are equipped with air-conditioners. They are affordable. The canteen is average. Our college provides facilities for games like badminton, gully cricket, billiards, and TT. Music is promoted by the club. The music club has drums, guitars, etc.

content.Placements: The placement scenario of our college is not good. Many companies stopped visiting our college because of covid. Students have to find internships and placements by themselves.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus is small. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners, smart boards, speakers, and mics. Classrooms are one of the best in Bhubaneswar. Labs are average. The Wi-Fi facility is not good. Hostels are not good. They won't provide any facilities even after complaining. Previously, the Wi-Fi was good. The library is basic. It has a lot of spiritual books along with course books, regular newspapers, and magazines. Hostels are situated very far. The hostel provides personal bathrooms and regular cleaning services. The hostel rooms are large and well-ventilated. The hostel rooms are equipped with air-conditioners. They are affordable. The canteen is average. Our college provides facilities for games like badminton, gully cricket, billiards, and TT. Music is promoted by the club. The music club has drums, guitars, etc.

content.Placements: About eighty percent of students were placed in our course, the highest package offered was eight Lacs to the lowest being four Lacs. As per the last year, top recruiting companies include flipkart, deloitte etc. Almost ninety percent of students secure internships.

individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with a grand temple of Lord Shree Jagannath and good placements also.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Regional College of Management is not good for BCA.

content.Placements: Not a single student in our batch got placed through campus placements, but some students from our college got placed. Their education system for BCA is not good for anyone who comes from non-IT background and who wants to pursue a career in software engineering. Wipro, Infosys, TCS, Capgemini, and many other companies visit our campus, but none of them will hire a person with no knowledge about how things work. If you are a hardworking person and don't depend too much on teachers and self-study is your merit, then you get roles like system engineer, system analyst, software developer, software tester, network engineer, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. C.V. Raman University.
reviews.review_text: Everything provided in our college was up to mark.

reviews.review_heading: The college is best for everyone.

The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is above average.

reviews.review_heading: My college life in cv raman university.
reviews.review_text: One of the most beautiful campus in Chhattisgarh is cv ranam. There are many courses in cv ranam university and each course has its separate building. Hostel facility is aslo very good as the provide you with B.Ed table, chair and one almira. There are total 100 rooms in a hostel and there are only 3 students in each room. Medical, sports room, mess etc. All facilities are available in cv ranam.

reviews.review_heading: This college gave me an experience that resulted into a person that made me like myself.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection is better than average, the labs have well functioned, the classroom is student-friendly, and the best experience. Mess food quality is average & four times a week non-veg is served. And quantity is pretty sufficient, sports and games are available to all. And can be enrolled accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty, facilities, and good placement options.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there is a good canteen. We have good medical facilities and a good opportunity for sports. The library is very well organised and well-equipped with many books, and also the food provide by the canteen needs to be improved but overall those are also good for health.

reviews.review_heading: The college always provides placements but it also depends on your scores.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was very good. It had its library, sports center, and computer labs, and also a technological equipment lab. There were many courses that our college offered. You can take admission in any of them of your choice and enjoy the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it was not a good experience.
reviews.review_text: Our college had a good infrastructure. All lab equipment was available. Every book was available in the library. It had a good canteen with good hygiene. Hostel facilities were good and rooms were quite big for the accommodation of 2 students. Every department had its well-equipped labs.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, and I suggest students to opt for our college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, washrooms, auditorium, restroom, staff room, principal office, playground, dance room, chemistry lab, physics lab, biology lab, basketball court and many more. The food served here is very good. A canteen, medical facilities, etc., available here are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good for BBA course with the low fee structure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility was good with clean with a hygienic environment. Proper maintenance of college and hostel were done. Medical facilities are quite good. Labs and library were available in the college in different departments. Classrooms were available in good condition.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college with good placements.

The campus of CVRU was awesome. The entire campus was Wi-Fi enabled with outstanding high-speed. A well-equipped library was available and had enough books for students. Hostels were new, but they didn't have any air conditioners. Water was available 24x7, and the bathroom conditions were good. Hostel was very good for students. Classrooms and labs were also good.
